是选用词句的方式；exact words 指实际说出的逐字原话。 narration / factual information Narration 按时间或情节组织事件；factual information 针对问题提供可核实内容，不要求形成故事结构。 phrasing / mode of expression Phrasing 关注某一句或短语怎样组织；mode of expression 是更稳定、更宽泛的表达方式。 counterquestion / trick question / leading question Counterquestion 以问题回应问题；trick question 设计为容易答错；leading question 通过措辞暗示或限制答案。 speaking style / pronunciation Speaking style 包括措辞、节奏、语气等；pronunciation 只关注语音如何发出。 conversation flow / turn-taking Conversation flow 是谈话整体推进是否连贯；turn-taking 是发言权如何在参与者之间转换。 right to speak / speaking time Right to speak 是程序上的发言资格；speaking time 是实际或获准使用的时间长度。 opener / close / conversation management Conversation opener 引入主题，conversation close 总结并结束；conversation management 贯穿全程协调提问、倾听和轮换。 communication level / communicative intent Communication level 指内容、关系或情感等层面；communicative intent 是说话者希望通过发言实现的目的。 undertone / hint / unspoken Undertone 是可感受到的附加态度；hint 是有意给出的部分线索；unspoken 表示没有明说但可能从语境理解。 state / assert State 是清楚陈述；assert 是坚定声称为真，语气更强，但不自动表示已经提供证据。 pose / inquire / seek clarification Pose a question 是提出问题；inquire 是较正式询问；seek clarification 针对已有但不清楚的信息要求解释。 restate / quote Restate 可用相同或略有变化的语言再说一次；quote 要准确标示并重现原话。 verbatim / in one's own words Verbatim 要求逐字一致；in one's own words 是保留意义的转述，不能使用引号假装为原话。 articulate / pronounce Articulate 在本篇主要指清楚表达复杂想法；pronounce 指发出单词的语音。Articulate 也可在语音学语境中指清晰发音。 --- 易混辨析 - say / tell ：说出具体内容 / 告诉某人，通常必须带接收者。 - speak / talk ：可用于正式发言和语言能力 / 更常用于日常交谈。 - ask / request ：提出问题 / 较正式地请求某物或行动。 - answer / respond ：对问题给出答案 / 对问题、事件或发言作出回应。 - hear / listen ：听见声音 / 有意识专注听。 - imply / infer ：说话者暗示 / 听者从信息中推断。 --- 语境回收 The interviewer used a neutral conversation opener and posed an open question. The witness gave an account of the event but used an indistinct phrase. The interviewer sought clarification, asked for the exact words, and listened attentively without interrupting. She then restated the account in her own words and checked whether the paraphrase preserved the witness's communicative intent. --- 自测 1. 选择：一段话实际采用的具体词语是 wording / narration。 2. 填空：A question that suggests an expected answer is a question. 3. 改错：A verbatim quotation may freely replace the original words. 4. 翻译：记者要求证人澄清这句话。 5. 选择：谈话中发言权的转换是 turn-taking / speaking rate。 6. 填空：Please the question in more neutral language. 7. 改错：Pronounce means to express a complex policy position clearly. 8. 选择：没有直接说出口的期待是 unspoken / indistinct。 9. 翻译：请让她把话说完。 10. 填空：The speaker's ironic changed how the sentence was understood. 参考答案 1. wording 2. leading 3. A verbatim quotation must preserve the original words. 4. The journalist asked the witness to clarify the sentence. 5. turn-taking 6. phrase 7. Articulate means to express a position clearly; pronounce concerns how a word is spoken. 8. unspoken 9. Please let her finish speaking. 10. undertone --- 上一篇 → 19-3 意愿与决定 下一篇 → 19-5 争论与说服

/ most well-founded 有充分、相关理由或证据支持的 a well-founded objection B2 unsupported more / most unsupported 没有给出足够证据或理由支持的 an unsupported assertion B2 contentious more / most contentious 容易或正在引起明显分歧和争议的 a contentious issue B2 固定表达 英语 中文（辨义） 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- put forward an argument 提出论点 B1 formulate a thesis 提出需要论证的核心主张 B1 back something up with data 用数据支持某事 B1 give a concrete example 举出具体例子 A2 raise an objection 提出异议 B1 disagree with someone 不同意某人的观点 A2 convince someone that 使某人相信…… B1 advocate a particular approach 主张采用某一方法 B2 stand by a position 坚持某个立场 B2 negotiate a compromise 协商达成妥协 B1 argue on the merits 就事情本身的理由进行论证 B2 build a consensus 逐步建立共识 B2 --- 精讲 reason / supporting reason / evidence Reason 解释为什么应接受结论；supporting reason 直接连接到特定主张；evidence 是可检查的资料、观察或数据。 thesis / assertion Thesis 是整篇论证准备支持的核心主张；assertion 只是以确定语气说出的陈述，可能没有论证。 example / proof Example 帮助说明或提供个案支持；proof 要达到相应领域确认命题成立的标准。单个例子通常不能证明普遍命题。 objection / contradiction Objection 是反对某观点的一条理由；contradiction 是两个命题不能同时成立的逻辑关系。 debate / controversy Debate 是组织化的意见交锋活动；controversy 是可能长期存在的社会、政治或学术争议。 argumentation / persuasive force Argumentation 是主张、理由和证据的组织；persuasive force 是它对特定听众产生说服效果的强度。 line / structure / chain of reasoning Line of argument 是贯穿全文的主线；argument structure 是各部分关系；chain of reasoning 是相互依赖、逐步推进的环节。 argument gap / counterclaim Argument gap 是缺少必要前提或步骤；counterclaim 是与原主张相反的陈述，本身也需要理由和证据。 credibility / evidential force Credibility 评价来源是否值得相信；evidential force 评价具体材料对特定结论支持多强。可信来源也可能提供不相关材料。 rebuttal / refutation Rebuttal 回应并削弱反方理由；refutation 旨在证明主张或论证不成立，所需证明强度更高。 rhetoric / polemic Rhetoric 是有目的地组织语言的宽泛方法；polemic 强调尖锐对抗和攻击，常弱化平衡分析。 convince / persuade Convince 常接观点： convince someone that ... ；persuade 常接行动： persuade someone to do ... 。实际使用有重叠。 support / prove Support with evidence 表示增加可信度；prove 表示达到确认成立的标准。证据“支持”结论不必然“证明”结论。 weaken / refute Weaken an objection 只降低其力量；refute 需要证明它错误或无效。局部削弱不等于彻底反驳。 convincing / well-founded Convincing 描述对听众有说服效果；well-founded 描述理由和证据基础充分。修辞有力的说法也可能缺乏依据。 --- 易混辨析 - argument / quarrel ：由理由构成的论证，也可指争吵 / 人际争吵。 - evidence / proof ：支持结论的材料 / 足以确认命题的证明。 - objection / counterclaim ：反对理由 / 相反主张。 - convince / persuade ：使人接受观点 / 促使人采取行动。 - rebut / refute ：回应并削弱 / 证明错误或无效。 - consensus / unanimity ：广泛共同认可 / 每一参与者都同意。 --- 语境回收 In the debate, Lea formulated a central thesis and added two supporting reasons. Another participant raised a well-founded objection and put forward a counterclaim. Lea did not simply repeat her assertion. She cited new data as evidence, acknowledged an argument gap, and narrowed the claim. The revised argument was more convincing, and the group began to build a consensus. --- 自测 1. 选择：等待论证的核心主张是 thesis / example。 2. 填空：A missing premise creates an argument . 3. 改错：One illustrative example necessarily proves a universal claim. 4. 翻译：请用可核查的证据支持这个说法。 5. 选择：证明原主张错误是 refutation / persuasion。 6. 填空：The source is credible, but the material has little evidential . 7. 改错：Convince someone to participate is always the preferred standard structure. 8. 选择：反方提出、同样需要证据的主张是 counterclaim / objection。 9. 翻译：双方最终开始逐步建立共识。 10. 填空：A statement made confidently but without support is an unsupported . 参考答案 1. thesis 2. gap 3. An example may illustrate or support a claim, but it does not necessarily prove a universal claim. 4. Please support the claim with verifiable evidence. 5. refutation 6. force 7. The usual structure is persuade someone to participate; convince commonly introduces a belief or proposition. 8. counterclaim 9. The two sides eventually began to build a consensus. 10. assertion --- 上一篇 → 19-4 说与问的动词 下一篇 → 19-6 同意与反对

B2 reject an application 拒绝或驳回申请 A2 lodge a formal objection 正式提出异议 B2 exercise a veto 行使否决权 B1 record an abstention 记录一票弃权；表示投票者未选择赞成或反对 B2 meet with opposition 遇到反对或阻力 B1 hold a different view 持不同意见 A2 --- 精讲 assent / consent / authorization Assent 是正式赞同；consent 是当事人对涉及自身事项表示同意；authorization 是有权主体允许行动。具体法律要求依场景和司法管辖区而定。 endorsement / advocacy Endorsement 是一次或明确的公开支持；advocacy 是持续为政策、群体或事业发声和行动。 concurrence / mutual accord Concurrence 是对某项判断表示一致，较正式；mutual accord 强调各方共同形成的协议或认可。 reservation / limiting condition Stated reservation 是仍然存在的疑虑或保留；limiting condition 是明确缩小同意范围或适用性的条件。 negative decision / declination notice Negative decision 是不批准、不接受的决定；declination notice 是把谢绝或拒绝结果通知对方的文件或消息。 opposing vote / abstention / veto Opposing vote 明确投反对；abstention 不选赞成或反对；veto 是有权主体阻止决定生效的正式行为。 dissent / sustained opposition Dissent 是明确持不同意见；sustained opposition 还强调反对在时间上持续并可能采取行动。 majority / unanimity Majority decision 只需达到规定多数；unanimity 要求相关参与者全部同意。高 approval rate 仍不等于一致通过。 statement / consent form Statement of agreement 是一般同意声明；consent form 记录对特定措施的同意，是否有效不能只凭签字形式判断。 veto / veto power Veto 是具体否决行为；veto power 是采取该行为的权限。没有相应权限的反对不能称为正式 veto。 opposing position / distancing Opposing position 是反方立场；distancing 是明确说明自己不认同某人或某言行，不一定提出完整替代立场。 boycott / formal refusal Boycott 是有组织地拒绝购买、参加或合作以施压；formal refusal 是对具体请求明确说“不”。 consensus-building / capacity Consensus-building 是寻找共同方案的过程；consensus capacity 是在保留差异时仍能达成方案的能力。 logical compatibility / incompatibility Logical compatibility 表示多项陈述可同时成立；incompatibility 表示原则、职位或要求无法同时满足。 approve / tolerate / consent Approve of 表示认为可接受，tolerate 表示虽未赞同但允许存在，consent to 表示本人对相关事项明确同意。 --- 易混辨析 - agree / approve ：同意观点或提议 / 认可某行为或方案。 - consent / permission ：当事人同意涉及自身事项 / 有权方允许他人行动。 - reject / decline ：明确不接受 / 较礼貌地谢绝邀请或提议。 - deny / disagree ：否认事实主张 / 不同意观点。 - abstain / oppose ：不投赞成也不投反对 / 明确反对。 - unanimous / without dissent ：所有人同向表决 / 没有人明确提出异议，程序含义可能不同。 --- 语境回收 Most committee members approved of the proposal, while two agreed only with stated reservations. One member cast an opposing vote and another abstained from voting. The motion passed by a majority decision, not by unanimity. Afterward, all members distanced themselves from an unsupported public statement without claiming that every remaining issue had been resolved. --- 自测 1. 选择：有权主体阻止决定生效的权限是 veto / veto power。 2. 填空：A voter who chooses neither side records an . 3. 改错：A majority decision necessarily means unanimity. 4. 翻译：两名成员有保留地同意这项提议。 5. 选择：承认对方某一点成立是 concede a point / reject outright。 6. 填空：The group remained divided opinion. 7. 改错：Consent and formal authorization always come from the same person. 8. 选择：有组织地拒绝参与以施压是 boycott / dissent。 9. 翻译：她公开与那项言论划清界限。 10. 填空：The two requirements are incompatible because they cannot both be . 参考答案 1. veto power 2. abstention 3. A majority decision may pass even when some members oppose or abstain. 4. Two members agreed to the proposal with reservations. 5. concede a point 6. in 7. Consent comes from the person affected; authorization comes from a party with authority to permit the action. 8. boycott 9. She publicly distanced herself from the statement. 10. satisfied --- 上一篇 → 19-5 争论与说服 下一篇 → 19-7 评价与批评

and disadvantages 权衡利弊 B1 give a sound judgment 作出可靠判断 B2 gain recognition 获得认可 B1 give explicit praise 明确提出表扬 B1 confirm the presence of a defect 确认存在缺陷 B2 draw attention to shortcomings 指出不足之处 B2 provide actionable feedback 提供可执行的反馈 B1 do justice to something 公正、充分地呈现或评价某事 B2 --- 精讲 appraisal / evaluation Appraisal 是仔细判断质量、价值或表现；evaluation 更强调预先方法、数据收集和目标成效。 expert examination / expert opinion Expert examination 是专业检查过程；expert opinion 是检查后出具的有理由判断，不自动等同于最终决定。 value / factual judgment Value judgment 依据价值、规范或偏好；factual judgment 主要依据可检验事实。实际评价常同时包含二者，应明确区分。 criterion / evaluation standard Criterion 是一项具体判断条件；evaluation standard 可包含多个 criteria、阈值和解释规则。 critical competence / self-criticism Critical competence 是恰当提出并接受反馈的能力；self-criticism 是把同样审视用于自己的行为和判断。 commendation / formal recognition / distinction Commendation 是正式表扬；formal recognition 是对价值或资格的承认；distinction 是授予的荣誉或优异等级。 quality rating / quality level Quality rating 是评审给出的等级或分值；quality level 是对象实际满足标准的程度，两者可能因评价方法而有差异。 performance gap / need for action Performance gap 是现状与目标的差距；need for action 表示该差距重要到需要采取措施，并非每个小差异都要求立即行动。 minor flaw / shortcoming Minor flaw 是范围较小的瑕疵；shortcoming 是未充分满足要求的方面，影响可大可小。 proposal / optimization potential Improvement proposal 是具体做什么；optimization potential 是仍可提升的空间，本身还不是行动方案。 plus point / merit / downside Plus point 是比较中的单个有利点；merit 是值得肯定的优点或价值；downside 是选择伴随的不利面。 appraise / evaluate Appraise against criteria 强调仔细判断；evaluate systematically 强调系统方法和目标成效。两者可以出现在同一流程中。 flag / complain / censure Flag a defect 是指出问题；raise a formal complaint 是进入正式投诉渠道；censure 是有权机构严厉批评不当行为。 qualify / differentiate Qualify a statement 是增加限制条件；differentiate between cases 是把不同情况分开处理，两者都能避免过度概括。 improvement-focused / well-calibrated Improvement-focused 关注下一步改进；well-calibrated 强调评价强度与证据和不确定性匹配。好的反馈通常兼具二者。 --- 易混辨析 - evaluate / estimate ：按方法系统评价 / 信息有限时给近似判断。 - critique / criticism ：分析性评价 / 批评的宽泛总称，可能只是否定。 - defect / error ：对象未达到要求的缺陷 / 行为、信息或计算中的错误。 - praise / recognition ：直接表达赞扬 / 承认贡献、价值或资格。 - improve / optimize ：使现状变好 / 针对明确目标和约束寻求更合适方案。 - positive / constructive ：评价结论肯定 / 即使指出问题也有助于解决。 --- 语境回收 The panel appraised every design against the same criteria. It acknowledged the strongest proposal's merits but flagged a performance gap in accessibility. Instead of giving an overly harsh judgment, the panel qualified its criticism, explained the need for action, and submitted two improvement proposals. The resulting feedback was proportionate, well-calibrated, and improvement-focused. --- 自测 1. 选择：按预定方法检查项目成效是 evaluation / estimate。 2. 填空：A measurable difference between current and target performance is a performance . 3. 改错：An expert opinion is automatically the final binding decision. 4. 翻译：请按相同标准评价所有方案。 5. 选择：指出具体问题但不进入正式投诉程序是 flag a defect / censure。 6. 填空：The reviewer the statement by adding an important exception. 7. 改错：Optimization potential is already a complete action plan. 8. 选择：与问题严重程度相称的是 proportionate / overly harsh。 9. 翻译：反馈应当具体、可执行并面向改进。 10. 填空：The design has clear merits, but its main is the high cost. 参考答案 1. evaluation 2. gap 3. An expert opinion informs a decision but is not automatically the final binding decision. 4. Please appraise all proposals against the same standard. 5. flag a defect 6. qualified 7. Optimization potential identifies room for improvement; a proposal specifies an action. 8. proportionate 9. The feedback should be specific, actionable, and improvement-focused. 10. downside --- 上一篇 → 19-6 同意与反对 下一篇 → 19-8 原因与条件

title: 19-8 原因与条件（Causes and Conditions）
text: 19-8 原因与条件（Causes and Conditions） 本组第 8 篇 · 共 9 篇 本篇 60 个主词条 + 12 个固定表达 精讲 15 项 场景导入 解释一件事为什么发生，要区分 cause、initiating factor 和 condition：cause 对结果具有因果作用，initiating factor 让已经具备条件的过程在某一时刻启动，condition 则限定结果何时可能发生。 逻辑上，necessary condition 表示“没有它就不行”，sufficient condition 表示“只要有它就足以保证结果”。统计上的 correlation 只说明变量共同变化，不能单独证明 causal relationship。 --- 词表 「地区」列 ：留空 ＝ 美英通用｜🇺🇸 ＝ 主要用于美式英语｜🇬🇧 ＝ 主要用于英式英语 「用」列 ：留空 ＝ 可放心主动使用｜👂 ＝ 听懂即可｜❌ ＝ 避免 名词标记 ：C ＝ 可数｜U ＝ 不可数； 动词标记 ：T ＝ 及物｜I ＝ 不及物 名词 英语 复数 / 可数性 中文（辨义） 典型搭配 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- --- --- initiating factor initiating factors；C 使已经具备条件的过程在某一时刻开始的因素 identify the initiating factor B2 effect effects；C / U 某原因、措施或物质产生的作用或结果 produce a measurable effect A2 observable outcome observable outcomes；C 能够通过观察或测量确认的结果 record the observable outcome B2 consequence consequences；C 从事实、行为或决定产生的后果 face a serious consequence B1 causal link causal links；C 两个事件之间可以由原因到结果解释的联系 establish a causal link B2 governing condition governing conditions；C 决定规则适用范围或过程能否发生的条件 specify the governing condition C1 required condition required conditions；C 为开始或实现某事必须具备的条件 satisfy a required condition B1 circumstance circumstances；C 伴随事件并影响判断的具体情况 under these circumstances B1 case cases；C 某一具体情形、实例或可能事件 in this case A1 purpose purposes；C / U 行动、措施或物件预期达到的用途和目标 serve a clear purpose A2 chance chances；C / U 事情偶然发生的可能性，也可指机会 happen by chance A2 causality U 一个因素作为原因产生另一结果的关系 investigate causality C1 causal relationship causal relationships；C 原因与结果之间可由机制或证据支持的关系 demonstrate a causal relationship C1 causal chain causal chains；C 多个原因和中间结果依次相连的因果序列 map a causal chain C1 correlation correlations；C / U 两个变量共同变化的统计关系，本身不证明因果 observe a strong correlation B2 conditionality U 某事由特定条件限制或塑造的性质 examine social conditionality C1 requirement requirements；C 为达到目标必须满足的规范、条件或所需要素 meet a technical requirement B1 framework condition framework conditions；C 对行动空间产生总体限制、通常难以短期改变的条件 economic framework conditions B2 boundary condition boundary conditions；C 模型、方程或方案在边界处必须满足的条件 define a boundary condition C1 initial condition initial conditions；C 过程开始时已给定并影响后续发展的状态 use identical initial conditions B2 constraint constraints；C 在主要目标之外仍必须遵守的限制 optimize under a constraint B2 success condition success conditions；C 目标能够实现所需的重要条件 create a success condition B2 effect pathway effect pathways；C 多个因素如何经中间步骤共同产生作用的路径 analyze an effect pathway C1 mechanism of action mechanisms of action；C 措施、物质或因素产生作用的具体过程 explain the mechanism of action C1 downstream effect downstream effects；C 首要作用之后沿系统进一步产生的间接影响 monitor downstream effects C1 secondary consequence secondary consequences；C 首要结果之外进一步出现的非核心后果 an unintended secondary consequence B2 long-term consequence long-term consequences；C 经过较长时间才充分显现的后果 assess long-term consequences B2 accompanying circumstance accompanying circumstances；C 与主要事件同时存在、影响其理解或进程的情况 note an accompanying circumstance B2 inevitability U 在给定条件下结果无法避免的性质 question the inevitability C1 causal role causal roles；C 某个因素在结果产生过程中实际承担的因果作用 establish the factor's causal role C1 root-cause sequence root-cause sequences；C 从最初原因经中间因素追踪到结果的分析序列 reconstruct the root-cause sequence C1 necessary condition necessary conditions；C 缺少它时结果就不能成立的条件 identify a necessary condition B2 sufficient condition sufficient conditions；C 单独具备时便足以保证结果成立的条件 provide a sufficient condition B2 confounding factor confounding factors；C 同时与解释因素和结果相关、可能造成误判的第三因素 control for a confounding factor C1 random occurrence random occurrences；C 无法由当前计划或已知确定规律预测的偶然事件 treat it as a random occurrence B2 动词 英语 变化 句型 / 支配 中文（辨义） 典型搭配 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- --- --- --- cause directly caused, caused T 作为直接原因产生可识别的结果 cause the failure directly B1 bring about brought, brought T 使某一状态、变化或结果实际发生 bring about a lasting change B1 give rise to gave, given T 导致现象、问题或结果出现，较正式 give rise to new risks B2 lead to led, led T 经由某个过程造成某个结果 lead to a delay A2 result from resulted, resulted T 由所述原因或条件产生 result from a technical error B1 rest on rested, rested T 以某事实、假设或原理为基础 rest on an unsupported assumption B2 depend on depended, depended T 是否发生或如何变化取决于某条件 depend on the weather A2 presuppose presupposed, presupposed T；presuppose that 把某条件已成立视为前提 presuppose prior knowledge C1 require required, required T；require A to do B 为实现某事必须具备或投入某物 require specialist equipment A2 prompt someone to prompted, prompted T 成为某人采取行动或重新考虑的原因 prompt the team to investigate B2 relate to related, related T 与另一事实存在某种关联，未必是因果关系 relate to the observed change B1 contribute to contributed, contributed T 作为多个因素之一促成结果 contribute to the delay B1 serve a purpose served, served T 对某一预期用途或目标发挥作用 serve a protective purpose B1 suffice for sufficed, sufficed T；suffice for / to do 达到某目的所需的最低充分程度 suffice for a preliminary test C1 favor an outcome favored, favored；英式拼 favour T 提供有利条件，使某结果更容易发生 favor a positive outcome 🇺🇸 B2 amplify amplified, amplified T 使影响、信号、趋势或程度增强 amplify the effect B2 attenuate attenuated, attenuated T 使影响、信号或程度减弱 attenuate the response C1 imply implied, implied T；imply that 一个陈述或条件在逻辑或语用上包含、暗示另一内容 imply a necessary limit B2 have a lasting effect had, had T 原因或事件结束后，其影响仍继续存在 have a lasting effect on daily life B1 correlate with correlated, correlated T 两个变量在统计上共同变化 correlate strongly with age C1 形容词 / 副词 英语 变化 / 用法 中文（辨义） 典型搭配 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- --- --- causal 无常用比较级 具有原因与结果关系的 a causal explanation B2 conditional more / most conditional 取决于某项条件、只在条件满足时成立的 conditional approval B1 necessary more / most necessary；逻辑义通常不用比较级 不具备时结果就无法成立的 a necessary condition A2 sufficient more / most sufficient；逻辑义通常不用比较级 单独具备便足以保证所述结果的 sufficient evidence B1 noncausal 无常用比较级 不构成原因与结果关系的 a noncausal association C1 固定表达 英语 中文（辨义） 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- be the reason for 是某事发生的理由 A2 be attributable to 可以归因于某原因 B2 have the effect of 产生……作用 B1 carry consequences 带来后果 B2 in connection with 与某事有关联；不自动表示因果 B1 on condition that 条件是…… B1 create the conditions for 为某事创造条件 B1 under these circumstances 在这些具体情况下 B1 in the event that 如果出现……情况 B2 an exception to the rule 规则的例外 A2 depend on something 取决于某事 A2 serve a particular purpose 服务于某一具体用途 B1 --- 精讲 initiating factor / cause Initiating factor 让过程在某一时刻开始；cause 对结果具有因果作用。触发因素可能只是较长 causal chain 中的一环。 effect / outcome / consequence Effect 是作用或变化，observable outcome 是实际观察到的结果，consequence 常强调行为或决定随之带来的后果。 causal link / correlation Causal link 表示原因到结果的联系；correlation 只表示共同变化，可能由反向因果、共同原因或随机误差产生。 condition / requirement / constraint Condition 决定何时成立；requirement 是必须满足的要求；constraint 是优化或行动时不能违反的限制。 framework / boundary / initial condition Framework condition 塑造总体行动空间；boundary condition 规定模型边界；initial condition 描述过程开始时的状态。 causal chain / root-cause sequence Causal chain 描述相连的因果序列；root-cause sequence 强调调查中从初始原因追踪中间因素到结果的分析结构。 effect pathway / mechanism of action Effect pathway 是从因素到结果的完整路径；mechanism of action 解释作用通过什么具体过程发生。 downstream / side / long-term consequence Downstream effect 沿系统进一步出现；secondary consequence 不是主要目标；long-term consequence 在较久以后显现，三类可以重叠。 necessary / sufficient condition Necessary condition 缺失时结果不可能成立；sufficient condition 单独满足便保证结果。必要条件通常不单独充分。 confounding factor Confounding factor 同时关联所研究因素与结果，若不控制，可能把第三因素的作用误认为目标因素的作用。 causal role / inevitability 证明某因素具有 causal role 不表示结果必然发生；多因素系统中，同一原因的效果可能受条件限制。 cause / contribute to Cause directly 把某因素描述为直接原因；contribute to 只表示它是若干促成因素之一，断言强度更低。 relate to / correlate with Relate to 是宽泛关联；correlate with 是变量共同变化的统计关系。两者都不应自动改写为 cause。 imply / lead to Imply 描述逻辑或语用包含关系；lead to 描述过程产生结果。逻辑蕴含不等于时间因果。 causal / noncausal Causal 明确声称原因关系；noncausal association 表示变量相关但不把其中一个视为另一个的原因。 --- 易混辨析 - cause / reason ：产生结果的原因 / 对事实或行动的解释理由。 - trigger / cause ：让过程开始的触发因素 / 对结果有因果作用的因素。 - effect / purpose ：实际产生的作用 / 预期达到的目标。 - condition / consequence ：结果发生前的限制 / 结果发生后出现的后果。 - necessary / sufficient ：没有它不行 / 有它就足够。 - correlation / causation ：统计共同变化 / 原因产生结果。 --- 语境回收 The delay resulted from several factors. A technical fault was the initiating factor, while a missing replacement part contributed to the long outage. The repair required special tools and depended on the weather. Good weather was a necessary condition for outdoor work but not a sufficient condition for reopening. The team therefore avoided treating a simple correlation as proof of causality. --- 自测 1. 选择：让已经具备条件的过程开始的是 initiating factor / long-term consequence。 2. 填空：A statistical association does not by itself establish . 3. 改错：Every necessary condition is automatically sufficient. 4. 翻译：备件缺失是延误的促成因素之一。 5. 选择：解释作用如何发生的是 mechanism of action / approval rate。 6. 填空：The outcome depends several initial conditions. 7. 改错：A factor with a causal role makes the outcome inevitable in every context. 8. 选择：同时关联解释因素和结果的第三因素是 confounding factor / boundary condition。 9. 翻译：这两个变量相关，但联系可能不是因果性的。 10. 填空：The evidence may a limit without describing a temporal cause. 参考答案 1. initiating factor 2. causality 3. A necessary condition may still be insufficient on its own. 4. The missing replacement part contributed to the delay. 5. mechanism of action 6. on 7. A causal factor may operate only under particular conditions and need not make the outcome inevitable. 8. confounding factor 9. The two variables correlate, but the relationship may be noncausal. 10. imply --- 上一篇 → 19-7 评价与批评 下一篇 → 19-9 抽象名词

title: 19-9 抽象名词（Abstract Nouns）
text: 19-9 抽象名词（Abstract Nouns） 本组第 9 篇 · 共 9 篇 本篇 60 个主词条 + 12 个固定表达 精讲 15 项 场景导入 抽象名词把事件、关系和判断压缩成可以继续讨论的对象。例如， because the system changed 可以名词化为 because of the system's gradual transformation ， whether the plan can be implemented 可以概括为 the plan's implementability 。 名词化适合标题、定义和专业文本，但过度使用会让句子沉重。写作时要在精确性和可读性之间平衡：如果一个抽象名词不能清楚说明“谁做了什么”，通常可以改回主动动词句。 --- 词表 「地区」列 ：留空 ＝ 美英通用｜🇺🇸 ＝ 主要用于美式英语｜🇬🇧 ＝ 主要用于英式英语 「用」列 ：留空 ＝ 可放心主动使用｜👂 ＝ 听懂即可｜❌ ＝ 避免 名词标记 ：C ＝ 可数｜U ＝ 不可数 名词 英语 复数 / 可数性 中文（辨义） 典型搭配 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- --- --- matter matters；C 需要处理、决定或讨论的事情 an urgent matter B1 state of affairs states of affairs；C 由相关事实构成的具体情况或现状 clarify the state of affairs B2 aspect aspects；C 观察或讨论一个主题时选取的某一侧面 consider every aspect B1 subject matter U 研究、文本、课程或谈话所涉及的内容对象 the subject matter of the study B1 topic topics；C 谈话、文本或研究集中处理的主题 introduce a topic A1 manner manners；C / U 行动发生或完成的具体方式 in a careful manner B1 concept concepts；C 用词语表达、具有一定内涵和适用范围的思想单位 define a concept B1 definition definitions；C 对概念含义和适用范围作出的明确说明 provide a precise definition B1 category categories；C 按共同特征划分出的类别 assign it to a category B1 domain domains；C 由主题、知识、职责或活动界定的范围 within the legal domain B2 framework frameworks；C 活动、讨论或理论的总体结构和边界 within a theoretical framework B1 stability U 系统在扰动下保持状态或恢复平衡的能力 long-term stability B1 tendency tendencies；C 尚未完全确定、但可以观察到的发展方向 an upward tendency B1 similarity similarities；C / U 对象在若干特征上接近但不完全相同的关系 a striking similarity B1 basis bases；C 其他行动、理论或判断赖以建立的基础 a sound basis B1 probability probabilities；C / U 某事件发生可能性的度量或程度 a high probability B1 necessity necessities；C / U 某事不可缺少、必须发生或必须采取的性质 recognize the necessity B1 ability abilities；C / U 人或系统完成某类任务所具备的能力 demonstrate the ability A2 opportunity opportunities；C 适合或允许做某事的具体时机 take an opportunity A2 demand demands；C / U 对资源、产品或服务的需要，也可指明确要求 meet market demand B1 meaning meanings；C / U 词语、符号或行为所表达的内容，也可指重要意义 explain the meaning A2 essence U 使某事物成为其本身的核心性质或根本特征 capture the essence B2 abstraction abstractions；C / U 从具体个案中舍去细节、形成一般概念的过程或结果 a theoretical abstraction C1 concretization concretizations；C / U 把一般目标、规则或想法转化为明确内容的过程 the concretization of the plan C1 generality generalities；C / U 不限于个别对象、适用于较广范围的性质 assess the generality of the claim C1 particularity particularities；C / U 使对象区别于一般情况的具体、特有之处 preserve local particularity C1 detail details；C / U 构成整体的一个具体部分或小信息 explain every detail A2 totality totalities；C / U 所有相关个体或部分合在一起形成的整体 consider the totality of the evidence C1 diversity U 同一范围内存在多种不同形式、背景或特征的状态 cultural diversity B1 multifacetedness U 对象由多个相互关联层面构成的复杂性质 the multifacetedness of the issue C1 complexity complexities；C / U 系统含有许多相互依赖部分、难以简单处理的程度 manage complexity B2 simplicity U 结构、使用或解释不含多余复杂性的性质 value simplicity B1 unambiguity U 表达或结果只允许一种合理解释的性质 improve linguistic unambiguity C1 ambiguity ambiguities；C / U 表达、符号或情况允许多种解释的性质 resolve an ambiguity B2 applicability U 规则、方法或结论对指定情境适用的程度 assess practical applicability B2 relevance U 信息与当前问题、决定或目标相关并有影响的程度 establish the relevance B2 significance U 事物的重要性、意义或统计上的显著程度 explain the practical significance B2 feasibility U 计划在现有技术、时间和资源下能够完成的程度 test the feasibility B2 implementability U 想法能够转化为具体行动、流程或制度的程度 improve implementability C1 accessibility U 信息、场所或服务能够被找到、理解和使用的程度 digital accessibility B2 completeness U 所有要求部分均已包含、没有缺项的性质 check for completeness B2 transparency U 规则、过程和依据能够被外部理解与检查的性质 increase transparency B2 traceability U 信息、决定或产品能够沿记录追踪来源和过程的性质 ensure data traceability B2 comparability U 对象可以按共同尺度进行有意义比较的性质 improve data comparability B2 transferability U 结果、技能或方法能够适用于其他情境的程度 examine transferability C1 robustness U 系统、方法或论证在扰动和假设变化下仍保持功能的程度 test the robustness B2 durability U 材料、关系或结果在时间中保持功能或状态的能力 long-term durability B2 effectiveness U 措施在现实中确实产生预期效果的程度 demonstrate effectiveness B2 suitability U 对象对于指定目的、情境或使用者合适的程度 assess suitability B2 usability U 产品或系统可被指定用户有效、顺畅使用的程度 improve usability B2 verifiability U 陈述、结果或过程能够由他人独立检查的性质 scientific verifiability C1 presentation form presentation forms；C 内容在文本、图像、口头或其他媒介中呈现的形式 choose a presentation form B2 mode of operation modes of operation；C 系统运行或行动实施的具体方式 explain the mode of operation B2 distinguishing characteristic distinguishing characteristics；C 用于识别、区分或分类对象的特征 identify a distinguishing characteristic B2 analytical level analytical levels；C 分析、组织或抽象所采用的层级 separate the analytical levels C1 thematic reach U 文本、项目或调查实际包含主题和对象的范围 broaden the thematic reach B2 process trajectory process trajectories；C 过程从开始到结束实际经过的发展路径 document the process trajectory C1 gradual transformation gradual transformations；C 状态随时间逐步形成的改变 observe a gradual transformation B2 relational pattern relational patterns；C 多个对象之间反复出现、可以分析的关系结构 identify a relational pattern C1 degree of specification degrees of specification；C 目标、规则或描述被明确到何种细节程度 increase the degree of specification C1 固定表达 英语 中文（辨义） 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- in this respect 在这一方面 B1 in content and form 在内容和形式两方面 B1 in the narrow sense 从较窄、较严格的含义说 B2 within the framework of 在某项目、规则或活动范围内 B1 step by step 一步一步地 A2 over the course of time 随着时间推移 B1 in contrast to 与某事形成对比 B1 in accordance with 与规定、事实或要求一致 B2 proceed from the assumption that 以某一假设为推理起点 B2 arrive at an insight 经过思考或研究得到认识 B2 draw a conclusion from 从材料中得出结论 B1 be of great significance 对某对象非常重要 B2 --- 精讲 matter / state of affairs Matter 是需要处理或讨论的事情；state of affairs 是由事实构成的现状，不一定要求立即采取行动。 topic / subject matter Topic 是谈话或文本聚焦的主题；subject matter 是课程、研究或作品实际涉及的内容领域。 concept / definition Concept 是思想和分类单位；definition 说明该概念的含义与边界。定义不是概念本身。 category / distinguishing characteristic Category 是按共同标准划分的类别；distinguishing characteristic 是用来把一个类别或对象与另一个区分开的特征。 framework / thematic reach Framework 提供总体结构和边界；thematic reach 是实际纳入了多少主题、地区、时间或对象。 stability / gradual transformation Stability 是系统保持或恢复状态的能力；gradual transformation 是随时间逐步形成的改变，两者可以同时存在于不同层面。 tendency / probability Tendency 是数据或行为表现出的方向；probability 是事件发生可能性的度量。趋势上升不直接给出某一事件的概率。 similarity / relational pattern Similarity 比较对象特征是否接近；relational pattern 描述多个对象之间反复出现的结构。 abstraction / concretization Abstraction 从个案中舍去细节形成一般结构；concretization 把一般目标、原则或想法变成明确内容。 generality / particularity Generality 关注结论适用多广；particularity 关注具体对象区别于一般情况的独特之处。 totality / detail Totality 是所有相关部分形成的整体；detail 是其中一个具体部分。可靠评价既不能漏掉整体，也不能忽视关键细节。 diversity / multifacetedness / complexity Diversity 是多种形式并存；multifacetedness 是同一问题有多个层面；complexity 是各部分相互依赖、难以分离处理的程度。 feasibility / implementability / suitability Feasibility 问资源技术下能否完成；implementability 问能否转为行动；suitability 问它是否适合指定目的。 transparency / traceability / verifiability Transparency 让过程和依据可理解；traceability 允许沿记录追踪来源；verifiability 允许他人独立检查主张或结果。 robustness / durability / effectiveness Robustness 是面对扰动仍保持功能；durability 是随时间保持；effectiveness 是现实中产生预期效果，三者评价维度不同。 --- 易混辨析 - topic / content ：在谈什么 / 具体包含什么。 - concept / term ：思想单位 / 表达概念的词或短语。 - framework / scope ：总体结构和边界 / 实际纳入的范围。 - necessity / demand ：某事不可缺少 / 对资源产品的需要或明确要求。 - meaning / significance ：表达的含义 / 重要程度或统计意义。 - feasibility / effectiveness ：能否实施完成 / 实施后是否产生预期效果。 --- 名词化提示 - 动词名词化常用 -tion/-sion ： evaluate → evaluation 、 conclude → conclusion 。 - 形容词名词化常用 -ness/-ity ： complete → completeness 、 possible → possibility 。 - 专业文本可用名词结构压缩内容，但日常写作宜优先清楚动词句： the implementation of the plan by the team 可改为 the team implemented the plan 。 --- 语境回收 The subject matter of the review was the project's gradual transformation. The original framework provided a useful basis, but its thematic reach was incomplete. The report therefore examined feasibility, implementability, and long-term effectiveness separately. It also improved transparency and traceability so that independent reviewers could assess the conclusion's robustness and verifiability. --- 自测 1. 选择：需要处理或讨论的事情是 matter / probability。 2. 填空：A precise explanation of a concept's meaning is a . 3. 改错：Feasibility and effectiveness ask exactly the same question. 4. 翻译：报告的主题覆盖范围仍然不完整。 5. 选择：把一般想法变成明确内容是 abstraction / concretization。 6. 填空：The ability to follow information back to its source is . 7. 改错：A transparent process is automatically fully verifiable. 8. 选择：在扰动下仍保持功能的程度是 robustness / durability。 9. 翻译：我们需要分别评估可行性、可实施性和适用性。 10. 填空：The conclusion may be important, but its practical remains uncertain. 参考答案 1. matter 2. definition 3. Feasibility asks whether it can be done; effectiveness asks whether it produces the intended result. 4. The report's thematic reach remains incomplete. 5. concretization 6. traceability 7. Transparency helps understanding, but verifiability also requires independently checkable evidence and methods. 8. robustness 9. We need to assess feasibility, implementability, and suitability separately. 10. significance --- 上一篇 → 19-8 原因与条件 下一篇 → 20-1 up 短语动词

title: 20-1 up 短语动词（Phrasal Verbs with Up）

bring up the issue 都可以；代词只能说 bring it up 。 - 例句 ：I didn't want to bring it up during lunch. — 我不想在午饭时提起这件事。 catch up — 赶上；补上 - catch up with someone ：赶上某人，也可指和旧识聊近况。 - catch up on something ：补做积压的工作、阅读或睡眠。 - 例句 ：I need the weekend to catch up on sleep. — 我周末得补补觉。 come up / come up with - come up 不及物：问题、话题或机会出现。 - come up with 及物：某人想出主意、计划或答案。 - 例句 ：A problem came up, but Leo came up with a solution. — 出了一个问题，不过 Leo 想出了解决办法。 end up — 最终变成或落到某种结果 - 常用 end up doing ，不能说 end up to do 。 - 例句 ：We missed the train and ended up taking a taxi. — 我们错过火车，最后只好坐出租车。 give up — 放弃；戒掉 - 接动作时用 give up doing 。 - 例句 ：She gave up drinking coffee in the evening. — 她戒掉了晚上喝咖啡的习惯。 keep up / keep up with - keep up something ：让某种水平、速度或努力继续。 - keep up with someone / something ：跟上人或变化。 - 例句 ：It's hard to keep up with all the updates. — 很难跟上所有更新。 live up to — 不辜负、达到 - 不可分，常接 expectations 、 reputation 、 promise 。 - 例句 ：The restaurant didn't live up to its reputation. — 这家餐厅名不副实。 look up — 查找 - 可分；代词必须放中间： look it up 。 - 例句 ：If you don't know the word, look it up. — 如果不认识这个词，就查一下。 make up — 编造；组成；和好 - make up an excuse ：编借口。 - make up 30 percent of ：构成百分之三十。 - make up with someone ：和某人和好。 - 例句 ：Children under 12 make up half the group. — 十二岁以下儿童占这个组的一半。 own up — 主动承认 - 用 own up to something / doing something 。 - 例句 ：He eventually owned up to breaking the window. — 他最终承认打破了窗户。 pick up — 捡起；接人；学会；好转 - 具体意思由宾语决定： pick up a bag 、 pick up a friend 、 pick up a language 。 - 例句 ：I picked up some Italian while living in Rome. — 我住在罗马时学会了一些意大利语。 put up / put up with - put up 可分，表示张贴、搭建或留宿。 - put up with 不可分，表示忍受。 - 例句 ：I don't know how you put up with that noise. — 我不知道你怎么忍受那种噪音。 set up — 建立；安装；安排 - 可分；代词说 set it up 。 - 例句 ：Can you help me set up the new printer? — 你能帮我安装新打印机吗？ take up — 开始；占用 - take up a hobby ：开始一项爱好。 - take up time / space ：占用时间／空间。 - 例句 ：The sofa takes up too much space. — 这张沙发太占地方了。 turn up — 调高；出现 - 调高设备时可分： turn the volume up 。 - 表示“出现”时不及物： Nobody turned up 。 - 例句 ：He turned up forty minutes late. — 他迟到了四十分钟才出现。 --- 易混辨析 ① come up / come up with / bring up - 一个问题自己“出现”： A problem came up. - 某人“想出”办法： She came up with a solution. - 某人“提起”话题： He brought up the budget. ② give up / end up - give up 是主动停止或放弃。 - end up 描述经过一系列事情后的最终结果。 ③ show up / turn up 两者都能表示“出现、到场”。 show up 在美式英语里尤其常见； turn up 在英式英语中更常见，但两者都能被广泛理解。 ④ put up / put up with put up 可分且含义很多； put up with 是一个不可分的整体，固定表示“忍受”。 --- 语境回收 English Our team set up a small online store last year. At first, orders were slow, but sales gradually picked up . Then complaints began to pile up because deliveries were late. During a meeting, Nina brought up the problem and asked us to come up with a better process. We followed up with customers, backed up the order data and cleaned up the tracking system. out of stock 暂时无货的 A2 out of breath 上气不接下气的 A2 out of place 位置不对的；与环境格格不入的 B1 out of touch 失去联系的；不了解最新情况的 B2 out of the question 完全不可能或不允许的 B2 out and about 外出活动、四处走动 B1 --- 精讲 carry out 表示按照既定计划、命令或程序“执行”，宾语常是 test 、 research 、 inspection 、 task 。代词放中间： carry it out 。 The team carried out a safety inspection. find out 强调通过询问、调查或经历获知原来不知道的事实。后接从句时不加宾语： find out why it failed ；了解某个主题可说 find out about the course 。 We need to find out what caused the delay. figure out 强调通过思考而理解或解决，常接 how / why / what 从句。它在美式英语中尤其常见，但其他地区也普遍能听懂。 I finally figured out how the lock works. turn out turn out + 形容词 / to be 表示最终结果； turn out for 表示前来参加或支持。不要把结果义写成可分结构。 The meeting turned out to be more useful than expected. run out 与 run out of 物作主语时用 run out ： The milk ran out. ；人作主语并说明用完什么时用 run out of ： We ran out of milk. 。 Our time is running out. rule out 表示根据证据排除可能性，不等于已经确定真正原因。可分，代词必须放中间： rule it out 。 The tests ruled out a serious infection. work out 本篇不把它列为主词条，因为它已在身体主题出现。除“锻炼”外，它还可表示算出、解决和最终顺利发展。 We can work out the details later. make out 常表示因距离、噪声或光线不足而“勉强辨认”。 make out that ... 还可表示声称某事为真，语气常带怀疑。 I could barely make out the sign in the fog. put out 可表示扑灭火焰、发布内容或使人费事。形容词 put out 还可表示不高兴，但正式学习时应先掌握 put out a fire 。 Firefighters put the flames out quickly. hold out hold out 可表示坚持抵抗或供应尚能维持； hold out hope 则是仍然抱有希望。具体意义取决于宾语和语境。 The village held out until help arrived. leave out 既可表示有意或无意省略信息，也可表示把某人排除在活动之外。代词位置是 leave it out 、 leave them out 。 You can leave out the final paragraph. phase out 强调逐步停止，而非突然取消，常用于产品、燃料、制度或旧技术。相反过程常用 phase in 。 The company will phase out the old model next year. back out 表示在已经同意后退出，常带失信或临时反悔的意味。后接事项时用 back out of 。 They backed out of the agreement at the last minute. miss out miss out on + 名词 表示错过机会、体验或好处。单独说 miss out 时，具体错过什么通常可从语境判断。 Book early so you do not miss out on the discount. watch out 用于直接警告时可单独使用；说明需要警惕的对象时用 watch out for 。它比 be careful 更突然、更口语化。 Watch out for the step by the door. --- 易混辨析 - find out ：通过调查获知事实； figure out ：通过思考理解或解决。 - leave out ：省略或排除； miss out on ：自己错过机会或好处。 - put out ：主动扑灭火； go out ：火或灯自行熄灭。 - run out ：某物耗尽； run out of ：某人用完某物。 - drop out of ：中途退出长期课程或活动； opt out of ：主动选择不参加某项安排。 --- 语境回收 During the system test, the connection timed out and the warning lights went out . We first ruled out a power failure, then carried out a detailed inspection. Maya figured out that an old component had worn out , so she took it out and replaced it. The repair turned out well, and we sent a message to spell out what had happened. --- 自测 1. 填空：We ran out printer paper. 2. 改错：The tests ruled a hardware fault out it. 3. 选择：通过思考找到解决办法用 find out / figure out。 4. 填空：They backed out the agreement. 5. 翻译：请执行一次完整的安全检查。 6. 选择：逐步淘汰旧系统用 phase out / wipe out。 7. 填空：Do not miss out this opportunity. 8. 翻译：结果证明这个传言是假的。 9. 改错：Please leave out it. 10. 选择：警告某人留意台阶用 watch out for / stand out from。 答案 1. of 2. The tests ruled out a hardware fault. / The tests ruled it out. 3. figure out 4. of 5. Please carry out a complete safety inspection. 6. phase out 7. on 8. The rumor turned out to be false. 9. Please leave it out. 10. watch out for --- 上一篇 → 20-2 down 短语动词 下一篇 → 20-4 off 短语动词

and on 断断续续地 🇺🇸 B1 off the hook 摆脱责任或困境的 B2 off to a good start 有一个良好开端 B1 off one's game 状态不佳、发挥失常 B2 --- 精讲 call off 表示取消已安排的活动，也可表示命令人员或动物停止攻击、搜索等行动。可分，代词必须放中间： call it off 。 They called off the match because of the storm. put off 表示把事情推迟到以后，常接 until ；表示使人反感时，人作宾语。不要把 put off 与“关闭”的 switch off 混淆。 We put the decision off until Monday. pay off 作及物用法时可表示还清债务；作不及物用法时表示努力终于得到回报。 pay something off 与 pay for something 结构不同。 Years of careful preparation finally paid off. pull off 表示成功做到原本很困难或不太可能的事，往往带赞赏或意外语气。可分： pull it off 。 The small team pulled off an impressive launch. go off 闹钟“响”、炸弹“爆炸”、食物“变质”都可用 go off 。具体意义由主语决定；它一般不带宾语。 My alarm went off at six. come off 可表示某物从表面脱落，也可表示活动取得某种结果。 come off as + 形容词 则表示给人留下某种印象。 The sticker came off without leaving a mark. cut off 表示供应、通话、交通或讲话被中断，也可表示把一部分切除。代词放中间： cut us off 。 The storm cut the village off from the main road. wear off 表示药效、疼痛、兴奋感或新鲜感随时间逐渐消失，是不及物结构，不能说 wear the effect off 。 The numbness should wear off within an hour. give off 表示物体散发光、热、气味或气体，宾语不能插入中间。与 give out 的“分发、耗尽”不同。 The device gives off a small amount of heat. head off 不及物时表示动身；及物时表示在问题扩大前拦截或预防。说目的地可用 head off for + 地点 。 Early action helped head off a larger crisis. let off let someone off 表示免除或减轻惩罚，常接 with a warning ；也可指燃放烟花或释放蒸汽。 The officer let her off with a warning. write off 可指会计上注销债务或资产，也可指过早认定某人、计划无望。 write someone off 往往带负面判断。 Do not write the idea off before testing it. brush off 字面义是拂去灰尘，抽象义是轻率地不理会意见、担忧或某人。比普通的 ignore 更能体现敷衍态度。 The manager brushed off our concerns. drift off 与 nod off 两者都可表示入睡。 drift off 强调慢慢进入睡眠； nod off 常指坐着时不小心短暂睡着。 I drifted off while listening to the rain. sign off 可表示结束邮件、广播或当天工作，也可表示正式批准。批准某事通常说 sign off on something 。 The client signed off on the revised plan. --- 易混辨析 - call off ：取消安排； put off ：推迟到以后。 - doze off / nod off ：短暂打瞌睡； drift off ：慢慢睡着。 - fight off ：主动抵抗威胁； scare off ：通过吓阻使对方离开。 - wear off ：效果自行消失； wash off ：用水主动清除。 - show off ：炫耀； come off as ：无意中给人某种印象。 --- 语境回收 The alarm went off just as I was about to doze off . A water pipe had burst and cut off the supply downstairs. We called off the morning session, but the maintenance team pulled off a quick repair. Once the disruption had tapered off , the manager signed off on reopening the building. --- 自测 1. 填空：They called the event because of the storm. 2. 改错：We decided to put off it. 3. 选择：努力最终获得回报用 pay off / write off。 4. 填空：She came off rather impatient. 5. 翻译：药效大约一小时后逐渐消失了。 6. 选择：正式批准设计用 sign off on / show off。 7. 填空：The thief made off the jewelry. 8. 翻译：他们成功完成了这次困难的营救。 9. 改错：The alarm went it off at midnight. 10. 选择：以玩笑淡化批评用 laugh off / brush off。 答案 1. off 2. We decided to put it off. 3. pay off 4. as 5. The medicine wore off after about an hour. 6. sign off on 7. with 8. They pulled off the difficult rescue. 9. The alarm went off at midnight. 10. laugh off --- 上一篇 → 20-3 out 短语动词 下一篇 → 20-5 on 短语动词

doing ；说明具体事项时用 carry on with something 。在英式英语中尤其常见。 Please carry on working while I answer the door. go on go on doing 是继续同一件事； go on to do 是做完前一件事后转做另一件事。这个结构差异会直接改变意思。 She went on to explain the 可表示转交信息、物品或传统，也可委婉表示去世。表示拒绝机会时常说 pass on the offer 。 Please pass the update on to the night shift. press on 与 push on 两者都表示克服困难继续。 press on 更强调坚定推进任务， push on 也常用于继续向前赶路。 Despite the setback, the researchers pressed on. dawn on 只用于某个事实逐渐进入某人的意识，典型结构是 It dawned on me that ... ，人不能作主语。 It suddenly dawned on us that the door was locked. grow on 表示经过一段时间逐渐喜欢某人或某物，主语是被喜欢的对象，人放在 on 后面。 I disliked the color at first, but it grew on me. sleep on 表示暂不决定，经过一夜思考后再答复。它通常用于不需要立即作出的选择。 I would like to sleep on the offer before replying. zero in on 表示从多个可能中把注意力精确集中到一个目标、问题或原因，比 focus on 更强调逐步锁定。 The investigation zeroed in on a faulty sensor. --- 易混辨析 - carry on doing ：继续同一动作； go on to do ：随后转做新动作。 - count on ：信赖、依靠； bank on ：把计划押在某个预期上，确定感更强。 - cheer on / spur on / urge on ：分别侧重现场鼓励、激发动力和言语催促。 - press on / push on / soldier on ：分别侧重坚定推进、继续向前和在困苦中硬撑。 - catch on ：理解或流行； catch on to ：理解某个具体事实或模式。 --- 语境回收 We embarked on the redesign in March and built on feedback from the first trial. When delays began to drag on , the team pressed on instead of giving up. We zeroed in on the main bottleneck, acted on the engineers' advice, and then moved on to final testing. The extra effort eventually paid off. --- 自测 1. 填空：You can count me to help. 2. 改错：Please cheer on them. 3. 选择：逐渐喜欢上一首歌用 grow on / play on。 4. 填空：It dawned me that I had the wrong key. 5. 翻译：我们继续进行实验吧。 6. 选择：以早期研究为基础继续发展用 build on / bank on。 7. 填空：She needs to sleep the offer. 8. 翻译：调查人员锁定了主要原因。 9. 改错：He took on it without enough preparation. 10. 选择：正式请某人回应用 call on / wait on。 答案 1. on 2. Please cheer them on. 3. grow on 4. on 5. Let us carry on with the experiment. 6. build on 7. on 8. The investigators zeroed in on the main cause. 9. He took it on without enough preparation. 10. call on --- 上一篇 → 20-4 off 短语动词 下一篇 → 20-6 over 短语动词

take over something 。 Lina will take over from me next month. --- 易混辨析 - look over ：快速查看； go over ：仔细复核； pore over ：长时间深入研究。 - think over ：独自考虑； talk over ：与别人商量。 - fall over ：失去平衡倒下； tip over ：倾倒； knock over ：被碰倒。 - come over ：到访； stay over / sleep over ：在别人处过夜。 - gloss over / paper over ：分别侧重淡化细节和掩盖未解决的矛盾。 --- 语境回收 Before I took over from Maya, we went over every open task. I pored over the risk log and asked her to talk over two options with me. After I had thought them over , I chose the simpler plan. It helped tide us over until the new system was ready. --- 自测 1. 填空：She took over the previous manager. 2. 改错：Please think over it. 3. 选择：长时间仔细研究数据用 pore over / gloss over。 4. 填空：The tension spilled over the next meeting. 5. 翻译：我们需要从头开始。 6. 选择：快速查看合同用 look over / tide over。 7. 填空：This loan should tide us until June. 8. 翻译：这场争议很快就会过去。 9. 改错：The evidence won over them. 10. 选择：尽快做完不愉快的事用 get it over with / turn it over。 答案 1. from 2. Please think it over. 3. pore over 4. into 5. We need to start over. 6. look over 7. over 8. The controversy will soon blow over. 9. The evidence won them over. 10. get it over with --- 上一篇 → 20-5 on 短语动词 下一篇 → 20-7 away 短语动词

someone's back 支持并保护某人 🇺🇸 B2 in the back of one's mind 隐约记在心里 B2 at the back of the line 在队尾 A2 a pat on the back 表扬或鼓励 B1 back in the day 过去、当年，偏口语 B2 --- 精讲 get back 不及物时表示返回；及物时表示取回。 get back to someone 表示稍后回复。 I will get back to you after checking the figures. go back 表示回到地点、时间或旧状态。 go back on 则是违背承诺，意义不同。 We cannot go back to the old system. hold back 可表示阻止前进、隐瞒信息或强忍情绪。可分，代词放中间。 She held back the final detail until the review. cut back 表示有计划地缩减规模；说明减少某种消费或习惯时用 cut back on 。 We need to cut back on unnecessary travel. bounce back 强调从疾病、失败或经济下滑中较快恢复，常接 from 。 Sales bounced back after a weak quarter. fall back on 表示主要方法失效时使用备用资源、技能或计划。 We can fall back on the manual process. push back 可表示推迟时间，也可表示反对要求或观点。语境决定是时间调整还是抵制。 Several teams pushed back against the proposal. set back 表示使进度延误； set someone back + 金额 还可表示花费多少钱。 The fault set the project back two weeks. roll back 表示撤销已实施的政策、价格或软件版本，常暗示回到先前状态。 Engineers rolled back the faulty update. walk back 除步行返回外，新闻和职场语境常指收回或弱化先前的说法。 The spokesperson later walked back the claim. trace back to 表示通过调查把当前结果追溯到最初来源。 The outage was traced back to a configuration error. circle back 表示暂时搁置后重新谈某个话题，常用于职场沟通，但不宜过度使用。 Let us circle back to staffing after lunch. fight back 可表示实际反击，也常与 tears 搭配，表示强忍眼泪。 He fought back tears during the farewell. think back 表示主动回想，常用 think back to + 时间/经历 ； look back 更偏整体回顾。 Think back to how the problem first appeared. bite back 表示把愤怒的话或反应强行忍住，宾语常为 reply 、 comment 、 tears 。 She bit back a sharp reply. --- 易混辨析 - get back ：返回或取回； give back / hand back ：归还。 - cut back / scale back ：都指削减，后者更强调总体规模。 - fight back / strike back ：都指反击，后者更强调对攻击采取回击行动。 - think back ：主动回想； flash back ：记忆突然重现。 - push back ：推迟或反对； put back ：放回原位或把时间后移。 --- 语境回收 The failed update set us back by two days, so we rolled it back and fell back on the previous version. Sales soon bounced back . I reported back to the team, promised to get back to the client, and then circled back to the longer-term repair plan. --- 自测 1. 填空：I will get back you tomorrow. 2. 改错：Please pay back it by Friday. 3. 选择：从失败中恢复用 bounce back / hold back。 4. 填空：We had to fall back the old system. 5. 翻译：这次故障使项目延误了两周。 6. 选择：违背承诺用 go back on / come back to。 7. 填空：The fault was traced back a loose cable. 8. 翻译：发言人后来收回了这一说法。 9. 改错：They rolled back it immediately. 10. 选择：强忍住愤怒的回答用 bite back / answer back。 答案 1. to 2. Please pay it back by Friday. 3. bounce back 4. on 5. The fault set the project back two weeks. 6. go back on 7. to 8. The spokesperson later walked back the claim. 9. They rolled it back immediately. 10. bite back --- 上一篇 → 20-7 away 短语动词 下一篇 → 20-9 through 短语动词

Please walk us through the setup. 3. fall through 4. on 5. We worked through the remaining problems. 6. skim through 7. with 8. An error slipped through the checks. 9. We made it through the night. 10. pull through --- 上一篇 → 20-8 back 短语动词 下一篇 → 20-10 around 短语动词

around, pushed around 可分；T 欺负或支配较弱的人 do not let them push you around B2 root around rooted around, rooted around 不可分；I；root around in 彻底翻找某处寻找东西 root around in a bag 🇬🇧 B2 run around ran around, run around 不可分；I 到处奔跑；为多件事四处忙碌 run around all day A2 scramble around scrambled around, scrambled around 不可分；I 急忙四处移动或寻找 scramble around for a flashlight B2 send around sent around, sent around 可分；T 向一组人传阅或群发 send the agenda around B1 shop around shopped around, shopped around 不可分；I；shop around for 比较多家价格和条件后再购买 shop around for insurance B1 show around showed around, shown around 可分；T 带某人参观并介绍场所 show the visitors around A2 sit around sat around, sat around 不可分；I 闲坐而不采取行动 sit around waiting B1 sleep around slept around, slept around 不可分；I 与多个不同对象发生性关系 rumors that he slept around B2 snoop around snooped around, snooped around 不可分；I 暗中窥探或翻查他人信息 snoop around in private files B2 spread around spread around, spread around 可分；T 在多人或多处传播、分发 spread the workload around B1 stand around stood around, stood around 不可分；I 站着等待而无行动 stand around doing nothing B1 stick around stuck around, stuck around 不可分；I 留在附近等候或继续参与 stick around after the talk B1 swing around swung around, swung around 可分或不可分；T / I 快速转向；绕行到另一侧 swing the camera around B2 talk around talked around, talked around 不可分；T 绕开要点而不直接谈 talk around the problem B2 throw around threw around, thrown around 可分；T 随意抛掷；轻率提出数字或权力 throw large sums around B2 walk around walked around, walked around 不可分；T 步行游览或绕过某处 walk around the old town A2 wander around wandered around, wandered around 不可分；I 无固定方向地闲逛 wander around the market A2 wheel around wheeled around, wheeled around 不可分；I 突然转身面向相反方向 wheel around in surprise C1 whip around whipped around, whipped around 不可分；I 非常迅速地转身 whip around at the sound C1 work around worked around, worked around 不可分；T 绕过限制找到替代办法 work around a technical limitation B2 wrap around wrapped around, wrapped around 可分或不可分；T / I 包裹或环绕在某物周围 wrap the cable around the hook B1 come around to came around to, come around to 不可分；T 经过犹豫后接受观点或决定 come around to our proposal B2 get around to got around to, gotten around to 不可分；T；get around to doing 终于抽出时间处理拖延的事 get around to replying B1 go around with went around with, gone around with 不可分；T 经常与某人结伴来往 go around with the same group 🇬🇧 B2 hang around with hung around with, hung around with 不可分；T 经常与某人一起消磨时间 hang around with classmates B1 mess around with messed around with, messed around with 不可分；T 随意摆弄；干涉；不认真对待 do not mess around with the wiring B2 play around with played around with, played around with 不可分；T 非正式尝试不同想法或设置 play around with the layout B1 bounce around bounced around, bounced around 可分或不可分；T / I 到处跳动；把想法交给多人讨论 bounce ideas around B2 skirt around skirted around, skirted around 不可分；T 避开敏感问题或障碍的核心 skirt around the legal issue C1 rally around rallied around, rallied around 不可分；T 集体支持处于困难中的人或目标 rally around the local community B2 固定表达 英语 中文（辨义） 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- around the clock 昼夜不停地 B1 around the corner 就在附近；即将到来 B1 all year round 全年 🇬🇧 A2 all around 四处；各方面都 A2 around here 在这附近 A1 somewhere around 大约、上下 B1 the other way around 恰好相反；顺序颠倒 B1 have been around 经验丰富；存在已久 B2 around and around 一圈又一圈地 B1 not have enough to go around 不够所有人分 B1 --- 精讲 get around 可表示四处出行、规避规则或消息传播。 get around to 则表示终于处理拖延事项。 I finally got around to answering the email. come around 可表示恢复意识、到访或改变看法。接受某观点通常说 come around to 。 She eventually came around to our way of thinking. go around 可表示传播、四处活动或数量足够分配。 There is enough to go around 是常见句型。 A stomach bug is going around the office. hang around 表示无明确目的地留在附近；接同伴时用 hang around with someone 。 I will hang around until the bus arrives. look around 表示环顾、参观或寻找。找具体物品时常用 look around for 。 We looked around the neighborhood before renting. show around 表示带访客参观场所。可分，必须说 show them around 。 I will show the new employees around. work around 表示不直接消除限制，而是找到替代路径继续完成目标。 We found a way to work around the software bug. shop around 表示购买前比较不同商家的价格、条款或质量，常接 for 。 Shop around for a better interest rate. mess around with 可表示随意摆弄，也可警告不要干涉危险设备。语气比 experiment with 更不严肃。 Do not mess around with the electrical panel. play around with 表示低风险、非正式地尝试不同方案，常用于设计、措辞和设置。 We played around with several color combinations. kick around 表示非正式地讨论尚未成熟的想法，可分： kick it around 。 Let us kick the idea around before deciding. dance around 表示刻意回避直接谈核心问题，通常带批评意味。 The statement danced around the question of cost. spread around 可表示把工作、资源或信息分散给多人。代词放中间： spread it around 。 We spread the tasks around the whole team. stick around 表示在预期离开时间之后仍留在附近，常用于友好邀请或等候。 Stick around for the questions after the talk. rally around 表示群体在困难时共同支持某人、组织或目标。 Neighbors rallied around the affected families. --- 易混辨析 - look around ：查看环境； shop around ：比较购买条件。 - fool around / mess around ：都可指胡闹，后者更常接设备或事物。 - dance around / talk around / skirt around ：都指回避核心，语气依次从形象到正式。 - hang around / stick around ：前者常无明确目的，后者强调留下不走。 - come around to ：改变看法； get around to ：终于有时间做。 --- 语境回收 We asked around for advice and shopped around for a better service. One supplier tried to dance around the support issue, so we looked around elsewhere. In the end, we worked around the technical limitation and spread the workload around . Even the skeptical managers came around to the new approach. --- 自测 1. 填空：I finally got around booking the appointment. 2. 改错：Let me show around them. 3. 选择：比较不同价格用 shop around / sit around。 4. 填空：She came around our point of view. 5. 翻译：我们找到了绕过这个限制的办法。 6. 选择：回避核心问题用 dance around / rally around。 7. 填空：A rumor is going the office. 8. 翻译：请留下来参加问答环节。 9. 改错：They spread around it fairly. 10. 选择：集体支持当地家庭用 rally around / boss around。 答案 1. to 2. Let me show them around. 3. shop around 4. to 5. We found a way to work around the limitation. 6. dance around 7. around 8. Please stick around for the question-and-answer session. 9. They spread it around fairly. 10. rally around --- 上一篇 → 20-9 through 短语动词

title: 21-1 连词与从句连接词（Conjunctions and Clause Linkers）
text: 21-1 连词与从句连接词（Conjunctions and Clause Linkers） 本组第 1 篇 · 共 5 篇 本篇 60 个主词条 + 10 个固定表达 精讲 15 项 场景导入 连词把词、短语和从句组织成完整关系。 and 添加信息， but 表示转折， because 给出原因， although 承认相反事实， unless 设置否定条件。真正的难点不在中文意思，而在它们连接什么结构、是否需要完整从句，以及前后逻辑是否匹配。 本篇还收录关系从句连接词和成对连词。学习时要整块掌握句型，例如 either A or B 、 provided that + 从句 、 the more ..., the more ... 。 --- 词表 「地区」列 ：留空 ＝ 美英通用｜🇺🇸 ＝ 主要用于美式英语｜🇬🇧 ＝ 主要用于英式英语 「用」列 ：留空 ＝ 可放心主动使用｜👂 ＝ 听懂即可，不必刻意模仿｜❌ ＝ 避免 功能词 / 话语标记 英语 类型 / 位置 中文（辨义） 典型用法 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- --- --- and 并列连词；连接同类成分 和、并且；添加信息 tea and coffee · She called and apologized. A1 but 并列连词 但是；连接相反或受限信息 small but comfortable A1 or 并列连词 或者；给出选择或替代 now or later A1 nor 并列连词；常接倒装 也不；补充否定信息 She didn't call, nor did she write. B2 yet 并列连词 然而、可是；表示出乎预期的对照 simple yet effective B1 for 并列连词；偏书面 因为；补充解释前句 We left, for it was late. C1 👂 because 从属连词；原因从句 因为；直接说明原因 We stayed because it was raining. A1 since 从属连词；原因 / 时间 既然；自从 Since you're here, let's begin. A2 as 从属连词；原因 / 时间 / 方式 因为；当……时；按照 As it was late, we left. B1 although 从属连词；让步从句 虽然、尽管 Although it was late, we continued. A2 even though 从属连词；强让步 即使事实如此、尽管 even though the task was difficult B1 while 从属连词；时间 / 对照 当……时；而、但 while I was waiting · While cheap, it is reliable. A2 whereas 从属连词；正式对照 然而、相比之下 City rents rose, whereas rural rents fell. B2 if 从属连词；条件从句 如果；是否（较口语） If it rains, we'll stay home. A1 unless 从属连词；否定条件 除非；如果不 unless you tell me otherwise A2 provided that 条件连接语；偏正式 只要、条件是 provided that everyone agrees B2 providing that 条件连接语 只要、条件是；同 provided that providing that payment arrives B2 as long as 条件连接语 只要；强调条件持续满足 as long as you follow the rules B1 supposing that 假设连接语 假设、倘若 Supposing that the train is late, what then? B2 whether 从属连词；间接疑问 是否；常与 or 连用 decide whether to stay A2 whether or not 条件 / 间接疑问连接语 无论是否；是否 whether or not you agree B1 even if 从属连词；假设让步 即使某事可能发生 even if it rains tomorrow B1 in case 从属连接语；预防性条件 以防、万一 Take an umbrella in case it rains. A2 once 从属连词；时间 / 条件 一旦、当……之后 Once you're ready, press Start. B1 when 从属连词；时间 / 条件 当……时 Call me when you arrive. A1 whenever 从属连词；任意时间 每当；无论何时 whenever you need help A2 before 从属连词；时间 在……之前 Check the address before you send it. A1 after 从属连词；时间 在……之后 after the meeting ends A1 until 从属连词；终止时间 直到……为止 Wait until the light turns green. A2 as soon as 时间连接语 一……就…… as soon as the results arrive A2 by the time 时间连接语；强调截止点 到……时候 By the time we arrived, it had closed. B1 now that 原因连接语；新情况 既然现在…… Now that we're ready, let's begin. B1 so that 目的 / 结果连接语 以便；结果是 Speak clearly so that everyone can hear. A2 in order that 目的连接语；正式 为了使…… in order that the process remain fair B2 lest 从属连词；正式目的 以免、唯恐 act quickly lest the problem worsen C1 👂 than 比较连接词 比；连接比较对象或从句 faster than I expected A1 as if 方式连接语 好像、仿佛 It looks as if it might rain. B1 as though 方式连接语 好像、仿佛；同 as if She spoke as though she knew him. B2 rather than 对比选择连接语 而不是 walk rather than drive B1 both ... and 成对并列连词 A 和 B 都 both accurate and clear A2 either ... or 成对并列连词 要么 A 要么 B either today or tomorrow A2 neither ... nor 成对并列连词 A 和 B 都不 neither cheap nor reliable B1 not only ... but also 成对并列连词 不但 A 而且 B not only faster but also safer B1 no sooner ... than 成对时间结构；常倒装 一……就…… No sooner had we left than it rained. C1 hardly ... when 成对时间结构；常倒装 刚……就…… Hardly had I sat down when she called. C1 the more ... the more 平行比较结构 越……越…… The more you practice, the easier it gets. B1 that 名词从句 / 关系从句连接词 引出陈述内容；指代人或物 I think that she's right. A2 what 融合关系词；名词从句 什么；……的事物 Tell me what you need. A1 who 疑问 / 关系代词；主语 谁；……的人 the person who called A1 whom 疑问 / 关系代词；宾语；正式 谁；……的人（宾格） the client whom we contacted B2 whose 疑问 / 关系限定词 谁的；……的 the student whose laptop broke A2 which 疑问 / 关系代词；事物 哪一个；……的事物 the file which contains the data A2 where 疑问 / 关系副词；地点 哪里；在……的地方 the office where she works A1 whoever 融合关系词；人 无论谁；任何……的人 Whoever arrives first can start. B2 whatever 融合关系词；事物 无论什么；任何……的事 Choose whatever works best. B1 whichever 融合关系词；有限选择 无论哪一个 Take whichever route is shorter. B2 wherever 融合关系词；地点 无论哪里 Sit wherever you like. B1 given that 原因 / 前提连接语 鉴于、考虑到 Given that time is short, let's vote. B2 assuming that 假设连接语 假定、如果 Assuming that costs stay stable, we can proceed. B2 except that 例外连接语 只是、除了……这一点 The plan works, except that it costs too much. B2 固定表达 英语 中文（辨义） 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- and so on 等等、诸如此类 A2 but for 要不是；若非 B2 or else 否则；不然 B1 if so 如果是这样 B1 if not 如果不是；即使不 B1 if anything 要说有什么的话；甚至恰恰相反 B2 if necessary 如果有必要 A2 when it comes to 说到、涉及 B1 as far as ... is concerned 就……而言 B2 be that as it may 即便如此、尽管如此 C1 👂 --- 精讲 and / but / or 三者连接语法地位相同的成分。并列完整句时可用逗号，但连接短词组时通常不用。 The room is small but comfortable. because / since / as because 最直接地回答原因； since 和 as 常把原因当作已知背景，其中 as 更依赖语境。 We postponed the trip because the road was closed. although / even though 两者都接事实让步， even though 对反差强调更强。后面不能再用 but 连接主句。 Although it was raining, we went out. if / unless unless 通常等于 if ... not ，但不适合表达“如果某事不是真的”这类需要明确否定范围的句子。 We will leave at six unless you call. even if / even though even if 引出假设条件； even though 引出已经成立的事实。 Even if it rains tomorrow, the event will continue. in case in case 表示提前预防，不等于 if 。带伞是预防动作，不是等下雨后才做。 Take a charger in case the battery runs low. when / once / until when 指某时刻， once 强调条件完成， until 强调状态持续到终点。 Stay here until I return. by the time 强调某个截止时刻，主句常用完成时表达在该时刻前已完成的动作。 By the time we arrived, the store had closed. so that / in order that 两者都引出目的从句； in order that 更正式。日常表达也常用 to + 动词 。 I wrote it down so that I would not forget. both / either / neither 成对连接的 A、B 应保持平行结构。接并列主语时，谓语一致要看具体结构。 You can either call us or complete the form online. not only ... but also 两端保持平行。 not only 位于句首并修饰完整从句时，前半句通常倒装。 Not only was it late, but it was also incomplete. who / whom who 作主语；正式语体中 whom 作宾语。日常口语常用 who 代替宾格 whom 。 Who called? / Whom did you contact? that / which 限制性关系从句中两者都可指物；非限制性关系从句通常用 which ，不用 that 。 The report, which was published yesterday, is online. whoever / whichever / whatever 它们本身包含“任何……的人/物”这一先行概念，不需要额外先行词。 Choose whichever option suits you best. given that / assuming that given that 把信息当作已知前提； assuming that 明确表示尚未证实的假设。 Assuming that demand remains stable, the plan is viable. --- 易混辨析 ① although / but although 引出从句； but 连接并列部分。标准句中不要同时使用 Although ..., but ... 。 ② because / because of because 后接从句； because of 后接名词短语。 ③ unless / if not unless 适合一般否定条件；需要突出否定对象或表达反事实时， if not 更清楚。 ④ who / which / that who 通常指人， which 指物， that 在限制性从句中可指人或物。 --- 语境回收 English Although the first test failed, we did not stop, because the cause was easy to identify. We checked the cable and restarted the device. Once the status light turned green, we ran the test again so that everyone could confirm the result. By the time the client arrived, the system was stable. We agreed to continue provided that the next two checks also passed. 中文 虽然第一次测试失败了，我们并没有停止，因为原因很容易查明。我们检查了线缆，并重启设备。一旦状态灯变绿，我们就再次测试，以便所有人确认结果。客户到达时，系统已经稳定。我们同意继续，条件是接下来的两项检查也通过。 --- 自测 1. 选择：后接完整原因从句使用 because / because of。 2. 填空：We'll wait here you return. 3. 改错：Although it was late, but we continued. 4. 翻译：即使明天下雨，活动也会继续。 5. 选择：提前带伞以防下雨使用 if / in case。 6. 填空：By the time we arrived, the store closed. 7. 选择：正式表达“鉴于时间有限”用 given that / assuming that。 8. 翻译：你可以选择任何最适合你的方案。 9. 改错：She asked that who had called. 10. 填空：The more you practice, the it becomes. 答案 1. because 2. until 3. Although it was late, we continued. / It was late, but we continued. 4. Even if it rains tomorrow, the event will continue. 5. in case 6. had 7. given that 8. You can choose whichever option suits you best. 9. She asked who had called. 10. easier --- 下一篇 → 21-2 介词与介词短语

title: 21-2 介词与介词短语（Prepositions and Prepositional Phrases）
text: 21-2 介词与介词短语（Prepositions and Prepositional Phrases） 本组第 2 篇 · 共 5 篇 本篇 60 个主词条 + 10 个固定表达 精讲 15 项 场景导入 介词说明名词与句中其他部分的关系。它们可以表达时间、位置和方向，也能表达原因、依据、方式、替代、让步和话题。 at 、 in 、 on 看似简单，却高度依赖搭配； despite 、 because of 、 in terms of 等结构则决定书面表达是否准确自然。 介词后通常接名词短语、代词宾格或 -ing 形式，而不是完整从句： because of the delay 、 without telling me 。需要接从句时，应改用相应连词。 --- 词表 「地区」列 ：留空 ＝ 美英通用｜🇺🇸 ＝ 主要用于美式英语｜🇬🇧 ＝ 主要用于英式英语 「用」列 ：留空 ＝ 可放心主动使用｜👂 ＝ 听懂即可，不必刻意模仿｜❌ ＝ 避免 功能词 / 话语标记 英语 类型 / 位置 中文（辨义） 典型用法 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- --- --- aboard 介词 / 副词；交通工具 在船、飞机、火车等上 welcome aboard the train B1 about 介词；话题 / 大约 关于；大约 talk about the problem A1 against 介词；接触 / 反对 / 对照 靠着；反对；以……为背景 vote against the proposal A2 alongside 介词 / 副词 在旁边；与……一起 work alongside experienced staff B1 amid 介词；偏书面 在……之中；在某局势背景下 amid growing concern B2 at 介词；点位 / 时刻 / 目标 在；于；向 at the entrance · at six A1 by 介词；施事 / 截止 / 方式 / 邻近 被；在……前；通过；在旁边 finish by Friday · travel by train A1 despite 介词；让步 尽管、不顾 despite the delay B1 during 介词；时间段内部 在……期间 during the meeting A2 except 介词；排除 除了……之外 everyone except Leo A2 following 介词；正式时间 在……之后 following the announcement B2 from 介词；起点 / 来源 / 分离 从；来自；离开 from Monday to Friday A1 in 介词；内部 / 时段 / 状态 在……里；在……期间；处于 in your request B2 固定表达 英语 中文（辨义） 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- at first 起初 A2 at last 最终、终于 A2 by accident 偶然、无意中 A2 by mistake 错误地、无意中 A2 in advance 提前 B1 in general 总体上、通常 B1 on average 平均来看 B1 on foot 步行 A1 under control 处于控制之中 B1 without exception 无一例外 B2 --- 精讲 at / in / on — 时间 at 用于具体时刻， on 用于日期和星期， in 用于月份、年份和较长时期。 at 8:00 · on Monday · in July at / in — 地点 at 把地点看作点或活动场所； in 强调处于其内部或范围内。 meet at the station · wait in the station in / into in 表示静态位置， into 表示从外到内的移动或状态变化。 She is in the room. / She walked into the room. on / onto on 表示已在表面， onto 强调移动到表面上。 The keys are on the desk. / Put them onto the desk. by / until by Friday 是不迟于周五完成； until Friday 是状态持续到周五。 Finish it by Friday. / Stay here until Friday. during / for during 后接事件或时期名称； for 后接持续长度。 during the meeting · for two hours because of / because because of 后接名词或 -ing ； because 后接完整从句。 We stopped because of the rain. despite / in spite of 两者都表示让步并接名词或 -ing 。不要说 despite of 。 Despite being tired, she continued. except / except for except 从同类集合中排除成员； except for 常指出整体评价中的局部例外。 Everyone agreed except Leo. / The report is clear except for one paragraph. beside / besides beside 是“在旁边”； besides 是“除此之外”，后者也可作句子副词。 Sit beside me. / Besides the fee, there is a deposit. between / among between 用于两个或多个可单独区分的对象； among 强调群体内部。 negotiations between three companies according to 用于引用外部来源或规则，不宜用来表达自己的观点。 According to the manual, the light should turn green. due to / owing to 都可表示原因； owing to 更正式。现代英语中 due to 已广泛用于句首。 The flight was delayed due to fog. in terms of 限定评价维度，避免把不同标准混在一起。不要把它当作空洞的“关于”反复使用。 The option is better in terms of cost. with / by — 工具与方式 with 常接具体工具， by 常接方法、交通方式或 -ing 动作。 cut it with a knife · send it by email --- 易混辨析 ① despite / although despite 后接名词或 -ing ； although 后接完整从句。 ② in front of / before in front of 通常表示空间位置； before 主要表示时间先后，也可用于正式顺序。 ③ according to / in my opinion according to 引用他人或资料；表达自己的看法用 in my opinion 。 ④ regardless of / despite regardless of 强调某因素不会改变决定； despite 强调结果与阻碍形成反差。 --- 语境回收 English According to the forecast, the roads may close because of snow. We will decide by six o'clock whether to travel. In case of severe weather, the meeting will move online. This is in line with our safety policy. Despite the inconvenience, everyone supported the plan without exception. 中文 根据天气预报，道路可能因降雪关闭。我们会在六点前决定是否出行。如遇恶劣天气，会议将转为线上。这符合我们的安全政策。尽管有所不便，所有人都毫无例外地支持该计划。 --- 自测 1. 选择：后接完整从句使用 because / because of。 2. 填空：Please finish the report Friday. 3. 改错：Despite of the rain, we continued. 4. 翻译：根据说明书，这盏灯应该变绿。 5. 选择：表示两小时的持续长度使用 during / for。 6. 填空：The changes were made in response feedback. 7. 选择：表达自己的观点用 according to me / in my opinion。 8. 翻译：除了一处小错误，这份报告很清楚。 9. 改错：She walked in the room.（强调从外面走进去） 10. 填空：We traveled train. 答案 1. because 2. by 3. Despite the rain, we continued. / In spite of the rain, we continued. 4. According to the manual, the light should turn green. 5. for 6. to 7. in my opinion 8. The report is clear except for one small error. 9. She walked into the room. 10. by --- 上一篇 → 21-1 连词与从句连接词 下一篇 → 21-3 程度词与强化弱化表达

title: 21-3 程度词与强化弱化表达（Degree Words and Intensifiers）
text: 21-3 程度词与强化弱化表达（Degree Words and Intensifiers） 本组第 3 篇 · 共 5 篇 本篇 60 个主词条 + 10 个固定表达 精讲 15 项 场景导入 程度词调节描述的强弱、完整程度和比较差距。 slightly 表示轻微， fairly 表示中等程度， extremely 表示极强， completely 表示完全。它们并非都能自由搭配：自然英语说 absolutely impossible ，通常不说 very impossible 。 学习时要分清可分级形容词与极限形容词，还要注意词序： very useful 、 old enough 、 far more useful 、 too difficult to finish 。 --- 词表 「地区」列 ：留空 ＝ 美英通用｜🇺🇸 ＝ A2 precisely 数量 / 描述前；较正式 精确地；正是 precisely the right size B2 nowhere near 形容词 / 数量前 远远没有、完全达不到 nowhere near ready B2 not nearly 形容词 / 数量前 远没有、不及 not nearly enough B1 all but 完成状态 / 极限前 几乎、差不多 all but impossible C1 much too 形容词 / 副词前 实在太、过度很多 much too expensive A2 far too 形容词 / 副词前 远远太、严重过度 far too risky B1 固定表达 英语 中文（辨义） 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- very much 非常；常修饰喜欢、感谢等 A1 not at all 一点也不；不用谢 A1 by far ……得多；常加强最高级或比较级 B1 to some extent 在某种程度上 B2 to a certain degree 在一定程度上 B2 more or less 或多或少；大致 B1 little by little 一点一点地、逐渐地 B1 by no means 绝不、一点也不 B2 not in the least 一点也不 B2 every bit as 完全同样地 B2 --- 精讲 very / really very 主要修饰分级形容词和副词； really 还可修饰动词： really like 。 The instructions are very clear. quite 与分级形容词搭配常是“相当”，与极限形容词搭配可表示“完全”。英美语感有细微差异。 The task is quite difficult, but the answer is quite certain. fairly / rather fairly 常给出温和、可接受的评价； rather 较强，常带意外或不满意。 The room is fairly large but rather dark. slightly / somewhat 两者都弱化程度。 slightly 更精确地表示小差异， somewhat 更正式且范围稍宽。 The revised estimate is slightly lower. barely / hardly 两者都带否定意义。 barely 强调刚达到最低限度； hardly 强调几乎没有发生。 We barely had enough time. almost / nearly 多数场景可互换； almost 搭配范围更广，可修饰 everyone 、 never 等。 Almost everyone agreed. completely / absolutely 常与极限或不可分级形容词搭配： completely wrong 、 absolutely impossible 。 The two designs are completely different. fully / thoroughly fully 强调达到完整状态； thoroughly 强调过程全面、没有遗漏。 Read the instructions thoroughly before you begin. highly / deeply / strongly 三者有搭配偏好： highly effective 、 deeply concerned 、 strongly recommend 。 We strongly recommend a full backup. significantly / substantially 都表示明显变化； significantly 强调差异值得注意， substantially 强调幅度很大。 The update significantly reduced loading time. too / enough too 放在形容词前，表示超过合适程度； enough 放在形容词后、名词前。 It is too heavy to lift but small enough to store. such / so such 修饰名词短语： such a problem ； so 修饰形容词或副词： so difficult 。 It was such a useful session. much / even + 比较级 两者都能加强比较级。 much 强调差距大， even 强调在已有程度上进一步增加。 The second version is much easier to use. not nearly / nowhere near 都表示远未达到， nowhere near 语气更强、更口语化。 The work is nowhere near complete. just / only just 可表示恰好、刚刚或仅仅； only 主要限定范围。位置不同可能改变焦点。 We have just enough time for one more question. --- 易混辨析 ① very / absolutely very 配分级形容词； absolutely 常配极限形容词，如 absolutely essential 。 ② too / very very 只加强程度； too 表示超过需要或可接受的限度。 ③ enough / sufficiently enough 更日常，且形容词后置； sufficiently 较正式，放在形容词前。 ④ almost / most almost 是“几乎”； most 是“大多数”或最高级，二者不可混用。 --- 语境回收 English The first draft was fairly clear but slightly too long. The revised version is much shorter and significantly easier to scan. It is not completely finished, but it is nearly ready. The examples are highly relevant, and the instructions are clear enough for a new user. One section is far too technical and needs simpler wording. 中文 第一稿还算清楚，但稍微太长。修订版短得多，也明显更容易浏览。它还没有完全完成，但已经接近就绪。例子非常贴切，说明也足够清楚，新用户能够理解。只有一节实在太技术化，需要更简单的措辞。 --- 自测 1. 选择：修饰动词 like 使用 really / very。 2. 填空：The box is small to fit under the desk. 3. 改错：The task is enough easy. 4. 翻译：第二个方案便宜得多。 5. 选择：搭配 impossible 更自然的是 very / absolutely。 6. 填空：We had enough time to finish.（勉强） 7. 选择：“远未完成”用 nowhere near / almost。 8. 翻译：我强烈建议先备份。 9. 改错：It was so a useful meeting. 10. 填空：The update reduced loading time.（显著地） 答案 1. really 2. enough 3. The task is easy enough. 4. The second option is much cheaper. 5. absolutely 6. barely 7. nowhere near 8. I strongly recommend making a backup first. 9. It was such a useful meeting. 10. significantly --- 上一篇 → 21-2 介词与介词短语 下一篇 → 21-4 话语标记与填充词

title: 21-4 话语标记与填充词（Discourse Markers and Fillers）
text: 21-4 话语标记与填充词（Discourse Markers and Fillers） 本组第 4 篇 · 共 5 篇 本篇 50 个主词条 + 10 个固定表达 精讲 15 项 场景导入 真实对话并不是一句接一句的完美书面语。说话人会用 well 开始一个不那么直接的回答，用 actually 纠正预期，用 anyway 拉回主线，也会用 I mean 重述刚才的话。 这些词本身信息量不大，却决定话语听起来是否自然。学习时不要只背中文，要记它们在对话中承担的动作：开启、转折、补充、纠正、举例、总结或争取思考时间。 --- 词表 「地区」列 ：留空 ＝ 美英通用｜🇺🇸 ＝ 主要用于美式英语｜🇬🇧 ＝ 主要用于英式英语 「用」列 ：留空 ＝ 可放心主动使用｜👂 ＝ 听懂即可，不必刻意模仿｜❌ ＝ 避免 逗号表示典型停顿，不代表所有位置都必须机械加逗号。 功能词 / 话语标记 英语 类型 / 位置 中文（辨义） 典型用法 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- --- --- well 回应开头 嗯、这个嘛；给不直接的回答留出空间 Well, I'm not sure. A2 so 话题开头 / 结果 那么；所以；开启下一步或给出结果 So, what do we do next? A2 okay 回应 / 转场 好；行；表示接受或进入下一步 Okay, let's get started. A1 right 回应 / 转场 好、对；确认理解或重新集中注意 Right, where were we? A2 actually 常在句首或助动词后 其实；纠正对方预期，不等于 currently Actually, I ordered tea. A2 basically 常在句首 简单说；省略细节后给出核心 Basically, we need more time. B1 anyway 常在句首或句尾 不管怎样；拉回主线、结束岔题 Anyway, let's move on. B1 anyhow 常在句首 无论如何；功能近似 anyway，频率较低 Anyhow, we got home safely. B2 👂 by the way 通常在句首 顺便说一句；引入相关但非主线的信息 By the way, Mia called. A2 I mean 重述前 我的意思是；修正或解释刚说的话 It was odd—I mean, unexpected. A2 you know 句中或句尾 你知道的；确认共享信息或争取思考时间 It's difficult, you know. A2 you see 通常在解释前 你看；引出对方可能不知道的原因 You see, I had no choice. B1 like 非正式口语填充 比如说；也可只是填充停顿 It was, like, really awkward. B1 👂 sort of 形容词或动词前 有点、算是；降低断言强度 I'm sort of tired. B1 kind of 形容词或动词前 有点、某种程度上；口语常用 It kind of makes sense. B1 maybe 句子副词，最常放句首 也许；口语中常用，也可缓和建议 Maybe we should wait. A1 perhaps 句首或谓语前 也许；比 maybe 稍正式 Perhaps there's another way. A2 probably 助动词后 / 实义动词前 很可能；把握高于 maybe She'll probably agree. A2 apparently 常在句首 据说／看来；信息来自迹象或他人 Apparently, the train was cancelled. B2 obviously 常在句首或谓语前 显然；暗示信息容易看出，使用不当会显得居高临下 Obviously, safety comes first. B1 clearly 常在句首或谓语前 很明显；强调证据或表达清楚 Clearly, something went wrong. B1 honestly 常在句首 说实话；强调真诚，有时表达不耐烦 Honestly, I don't remember. B1 frankly 常在句首 坦率地说；比 honestly 更直接 Frankly, the plan is unrealistic. B2 seriously 句首 / 独立回应 说真的；严肃地；也可表示惊讶 Seriously, we need to talk. B1 personally 常在句首 就我个人而言；明确这是个人看法 Personally, I'd choose the first one. B1 luckily 常在句首 幸运的是；评价结果对说话人有利 Luckily, nobody was hurt. A2 unfortunately 常在句首 遗憾的是；礼貌引出坏消息 Unfortunately, we're fully booked. A2 surprisingly 常在句首 令人意外的是 Surprisingly, the test was easy. B1 first of all 列举开头 首先；强调第一点 First of all, check the address. A2 to begin with 说明第一点 / 原始状态 首先；也可表示“一开始” To begin with, we need a budget. B1 then 顺序 / 推论 然后；那么；连接下一步或推论 Then press the green button. A1 next 顺序标记 接下来 Next, add the flour. A1 meanwhile 常在句首 与此同时；切换到同期发生的事情 Meanwhile, Sam called the police. B1 in fact 常在句首 事实上；加强、纠正或补充前句 It wasn't cheap. In fact, it was costly. B1 for example 举例前 例如；给出一个代表性例子 Try a team sport, for example basketball. A2 for instance 举例前 例如；功能与 for example 相同，稍正式 Some birds, for instance penguins, cannot fly. B1 on the other hand 对照观点前 另一方面；引出相反或制衡因素 It's expensive. On the other hand, it lasts. B1 however 通常在句首并接逗号 然而；正式转折，不能直接照搬 but 的标点 However, we decided to continue. B1 still 常在句首或助动词前 尽管如此；仍然 It was risky. Still, we tried. B1 though 常在句尾或从句开头 不过；句尾用法在口语中很自然 It was useful. Expensive, though. B1 instead 常在句首或句尾 反而、改为；表示替代方案 We stayed home instead. A2 besides 常在句首 况且、再说；补充支持理由 Besides, we don't have time. B1 also 助动词后 / 实义动词前 也；中性补充信息 She also speaks Spanish. A1 plus 非正式，常在句首 而且、再说；补充一个实际理由 Plus, it's cheaper. B1 therefore 常在句首或分号后 因此；书面和正式口语常见 The road was closed; therefore, we turned back. B2 as a result 常在句首 因此、结果；明确连接原因和结果 As a result, the launch was delayed. B1 after all 句首或句尾 毕竟；提醒对方考虑已知理由 We should invite her. She helped us, after all. B1 at least 句首或所修饰成分前 至少；指出最低限度或坏事中的好处 At least nobody was hurt. A2 in other words 重述前 换句话说；用更清楚的方式改述 In other words, the deal is off. B1 overall 通常在句首 总体而言；综合多个方面后评价 Overall, the event went well. B1 固定表达 英语 中文（辨义） 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- let me think 让我想想；自然争取思考时间 A2 how should I put it? 我该怎么说呢；寻找合适措辞 B1 what I mean is… 我的意思是……；明确开始重述 B1 the thing is… 问题是／实际情况是……；引出关键解释 B1 as I was saying… 正如我刚才所说；岔开后回到原话 B2 where was I? 我刚说到哪儿了 B1 come to think of it… 这么一想……；突然想起相关信息 B2 if you ask me… 要我说的话；主动给个人意见 B1 having said that… 话虽如此；补充限制或相反方面 B2 long story short… 长话短说；跳过过程直接说结果 B1 --- 精讲 well — 让回答不那么生硬 well 常放在不同意、拒绝或复杂回答之前，为说话人留出思考和缓冲空间。 例句 ：Well, I agree with the goal, but not the schedule. — 嗯，我赞同这个目标，但不赞同这个时间安排。 so — 开启下一步 除了表示结果， so 还能开启话题、恢复会议或推动对话进入下一步。 例句 ：So, shall we book the tickets now? — 那么，我们现在订票吗？ actually — 纠正预期 actually 是“其实、实际上”，不是“目前”。“目前”通常用 currently 或 at the moment 。 例句 ：I thought it was Thursday, but it's actually Friday. — 我以为今天是周四，其实是周五。 anyway — 拉回主线 用于结束岔题、接受无法改变的情况，或重新回到主要内容。 例句 ：Anyway, what were you saying about the new job? — 对了，你刚才说新工作怎么了？ by the way — 顺便换到相关话题 它引入的内容通常不是当前主线，但和谈话双方有关；不要在正式文章中过度使用。 例句 ：By the way, did you get my message? — 顺便问一下，你收到我的消息了吗？ I mean — 修正或解释自己 既可以纠正用词，也可以补充真正想表达的意思。 例句 ：It's not impossible. I mean, we just need more time. — 这并非不可能，我是说，我们只是需要更多时间。 you know — 确认共享理解 有实际功能时很自然；每句话反复添加就会变成干扰理解的口头禅。 例句 ：It's one of those days, you know? — 就是那种诸事不顺的一天，你懂的。 like — 举例与填充 like 可以正常表示“比如”，也常被用作无实义填充。学习者应能听懂，但不必刻意大量模仿填充用法。 例句 ：We could do something outdoors, like cycling. — 我们可以做点户外活动，比如骑车。 sort of / kind of 两者都能降低断言强度，接近“有点、算是”。 kind of 在美式口语中特别常见，但并非美国专用。 例句 ：I kind of expected that to happen. — 我多少料到会发生这件事。 apparently — 根据间接信息判断 说话人通常不是直接确认者，而是根据别人所说或现有迹象得知。 例句 ：Apparently, the office will close early today. — 听说办公室今天会提前关门。 obviously — 小心“这不是明摆着吗”的语气 它能强调结论清楚，但对人解释时可能暗示“你本来就应该知道”。 例句 ：Obviously, we need to protect customer data. — 显然，我们需要保护客户数据。 however / though however 较正式，句首常接逗号。 though 放在句尾是很自然的口语转折。 例句 ：The room was small. It was comfortable, though. — 房间很小，不过挺舒服。 besides / plus 两者都能补充理由； besides 中性， plus 更口语。 例句 ：Let's walk. It's nearby, and besides, parking is difficult. — 我们走路吧。那里很近，而且停车也困难。 therefore / as a result 两者都连接结果。 therefore 更正式、逻辑感更强； as a result 在说明事实结果时更自然。 例句 ：Demand fell. As a result, production was reduced. — 需求下降，因此产量被削减。 having said that — 承认前述后补充限制 它不是彻底推翻上一句，而是告诉听者“还要考虑另一面”。 例句 ：The job is demanding. Having said that, I'm learning a lot. — 这份工作要求很高。话虽如此，我也学到了很多。 --- 易混辨析 ① actually / currently - actually ：其实、事实上，用来纠正认知。 - currently ：目前、当前，表示时间。 ② anyway / by the way - anyway ：结束岔题并回到原来的主线。 - by the way ：暂时离开主线，引入顺带想到的信息。 ③ maybe / probably / apparently - maybe ：也许，可能性不明确。 - probably ：很可能，说话人判断概率较高。 - apparently ：据说／看来，强调依据来自间接信息或迹象。 ④ however / though / still - however ：较正式地引出转折。 - though ：口语中可自然放在句尾。 - still ：承认困难后表示“尽管如此，后面的事依然成立”。 --- 语境回收 English Well , the meeting did not go exactly as planned. To begin with , two people arrived late. Then the screen stopped working. Apparently , a cable was missing. Luckily , Priya found another one. The presentation was long; useful, though . Actually , the customer seemed interested and asked several questions. By the way , they want another demonstration next week. So , we need to shorten the introduction and add a clearer example. Overall , the result was positive. Having said that , we should test all the equipment beforehand next time. Anyway , I'll send everyone the notes this afternoon. 中文 嗯，这次会议并没有完全按计划进行。首先，有两个人迟到了。然后屏幕又停止工作。听说是少了一根线。幸运的是，Priya 找到了另一根。演示有些长，不过很有用。事实上，客户似乎很感兴趣，还问了几个问题。顺便说一句，他们希望下周再看一次演示。所以我们需要缩短开场，并加入一个更清楚的例子。总体而言，结果是积极的。话虽如此，下次我们还是应该提前测试所有设备。不管怎样，我今天下午会把会议记录发给大家。 --- 自测 1. 选择：“其实今天是周五”使用 actually / currently。 2. 填空：The plan is expensive. , it may save time. 3. 选择：结束岔题并返回主线使用 anyway / by the way。 4. 翻译：顺便问一下，你收到我的邮件了吗？ 5. 填空：She'll arrive before six.（很可能） 6. 选择：句尾口语转折最自然的是 therefore / though。 7. 改错：Actually, I'm working here for three months.（想表达“目前”） 8. 翻译：换句话说，我们需要重新开始。 9. 填空：Demand increased. As a , prices went up. 10. 选择：根据别人所说得知消息使用 apparently / personally。 答案 1. actually 2. However / Still 3. anyway 4. By the way, did you get my email? 5. probably 6. though 7. I've been working here for three months. 8. In other words, we need to start again. 9. result 10. apparently --- 上一篇 → 21-3 程度词与强化弱化表达 下一篇 → 21-5 立场、推断与语气表达

title: 21-5 立场、推断与语气表达（Stance, Inference, and Modality）
text: 21-5 立场、推断与语气表达（Stance, Inference, and Modality） 本组第 5 篇 · 共 5 篇 本篇 60 个主词条 + 10 个固定表达 精讲 15 项 场景导入 立场表达说明说话人对信息有多确定、依据来自哪里，以及把内容当作事实、推断、可能性、建议还是义务。 certainly 表示高度确定， reportedly 与消息来源保持距离， might 表示较弱可能， must 可表示强推断或义务。 自然表达并不是越肯定越好。证据有限时用 seem to 、 may 或 as far as I can tell ，比武断地说 definitely 更准确；提出个人观点时也要区分坚定主张与试探性建议。 --- 词表 「地区」列 ：留空 ＝ 美英通用｜🇺🇸 ＝ 主要用于美式英语｜🇬🇧 ＝ 主要用于英式英语 「用」列 ：留空 ＝ 可放心主动使用｜👂 ＝ 听懂即可，不必刻意模仿｜❌ ＝ 避免 功能词 / 话语标记 英语 类型 / 位置 中文（辨义） 典型用法 地区 级 用 --- --- --- --- --- --- --- certainly 句子副词 / 回应 当然、肯定；高度确定 It will certainly help. A2 definitely 句子副词 / 回应；较口语 肯定、毫无疑问 I definitely agree. A2 undoubtedly 句子副词；较正式 无疑、毋庸置疑 undoubtedly the strongest option B2 admittedly 句子副词；常置句首 诚然、不可否认；先承认限制 Admittedly, the sample is small. B2 arguably 句子副词；论证性 可以说、有理由认为 arguably the most important factor B2 presumably 句子副词；合理推断 想必、大概 Presumably, they have already left. B2 supposedly 句子副词；转述且可能怀疑 据称、按说 The device is supposedly waterproof. B2 reportedly 句子副词；新闻来源 据报道 The company is reportedly considering a sale. B2 allegedly 句子副词；未经证实指控 据称、被指；避免当作事实 He allegedly altered the records. B2 evidently 句子副词；基于迹象 显然、看来 Evidently, the door had been forced. B2 necessarily 句子副词；常用于否定 必然地； not necessarily 表示未必 More expensive does not necessarily mean better. B1 potentially 形容词 / 分词前 潜在地、可能成为 a potentially serious problem B1 can 情态动词；原形前 能够；有时会；可以 It can be difficult. A1 could 情态动词；原形前 能够的过去式；可能；委婉建议 It could work. A2 may 情态动词；原形前 可能；正式许可 The result may change. A2 might 情态动词；原形前 可能；常比 may 更试探 We might need more time. A2 must 情态动词；原形前 必须；根据证据强推断 You must stop. · She must be home. A2 should 情态动词；原形前 应该；预期很可能 You should rest. · It should arrive today. A2 ought to 半情态结构；原形前 应当；合理预期 You ought to check first. B1 had better 半情态结构；原形前 最好；暗示不照做可能有不良后果 You had better save a copy. B1 need to 半情态结构；原形前 需要、必须 We need to leave now. A1 have to 半情态结构；原形前 因规则或情况不得不 I have to wear a badge. A1 be able to 情态替代结构 能够；可用于多种时态 We were able to finish. A2 be likely to 可能性结构 很可能 Prices are likely to rise. B1 be unlikely to 可能性结构 不太可能 The error is unlikely to recur. B1 be certain to 确定性结构 必然、一定会 The issue is certain to return. B2 be bound to 强预期结构；口语常用 准会、必然会 Mistakes are bound to happen. B2 seem to 证据印象结构 似乎、看来 The system seems to be stable. A2 appear to 证据印象结构；较正式 看来、似乎 The figures appear to be correct. B1 tend to 一般倾向结构 往往、倾向于 Prices tend to rise in summer. B1 be supposed to 预期 / 规则结构 按说应该；被要求 The train is supposed to arrive at six. A2 I think 句首 / 插入语；普通观点 我认为、我觉得 I think we should wait. A1 I believe 句首；较坚定或正式 我相信、我认为 I believe the plan is workable. A2 I suppose 句首；保留态度 我想、大概；勉强接受 I suppose we could try again. B1 I guess 句首；非正式推测 我猜、我想 I guess she's busy. 🇺🇸 A2 I doubt 句首；否定预期 我怀疑、不大相信 I doubt that it will work. B1 I suspect 句首；基于线索的怀疑 我怀疑、我猜想 I suspect the file is corrupted. B2 I assume 句首；未核实前提 我假定、我以为 I assume everyone has a copy. B1 I hope 句首；愿望而非预测 我希望 I hope the weather improves. A1 I fear 句首；正式负面判断 恐怕、我担心 I fear the deadline is unrealistic. B2 I agree 回应 / 句首；同意 我同意 I agree that safety comes first. A1 I disagree 回应 / 句首；不同意 我不同意 I disagree with that conclusion. A2 I would say 缓和观点 我会说、依我看 I would say the risk is manageable. B1 I would argue 论证性观点 我主张、我认为有理由说 I would argue that prevention is cheaper. B2 I must admit 让步式承认 我必须承认 I must admit that I was wrong. B1 I have to say 强调个人反应；口语 我得说 I have to say, the result surprised me. B1 as I see it 句首；个人分析 在我看来 As I see it, we have two options. B2 for my part 句首；个人立场 就我而言 For my part, I support the change. B2 to my mind 句首；个人判断 依我看 To my mind, clarity matters most. B2 as far as I can tell 句首 / 句尾；有限证据 据我所能判断 As far as I can tell, nothing is missing. B2 it seems that 非人称判断结构 看来、似乎 It seems that demand is falling. B1 it appears that 非人称判断结构；较正式 看来、似乎 It appears that the data were incomplete. B2 it is likely that 非人称概率结构 很可能 It is likely that costs will rise. B1 it is possible that 非人称概率结构 有可能 It is possible that we missed a step. A2 it is unlikely that 非人称概率结构 不太可能 It is unlikely that the train will wait. B1 there is no doubt that 确定性结构 毫无疑问 There is no doubt that the system failed. B1 there is a chance that 概率结构 有可能、有机会 There is a chance that it will snow. B1 strictly speaking 句子副词短语 严格说来 Strictly speaking, that is not a contract. B2 generally speaking 句子副词短语 一般来说 Generally speaking, the method is safe. B1 broadly speaking 句子副词短语 大体上说 Broadly speaking, the results agree.
